````rust
//! Schedule-bound native action realisations, independently derived from
//! ISA §§4.4, 4.7, 8.3, 11 and 12.1. The traversal includes default-covered
//! call contexts. Unsupported expansions terminate with an explicit reason.
use crate::cert::{
    host_limit_outcome, parse_invocation, rej, u64_of, ClaimOutcome, Inputs, Invocation,
    LoadedDocs, Subject,
};
use crate::eval::{list_items, parse_blocks, Stmt};
use crate::fault::HostLimit;
use crate::json::{jcs, n, s, Value};
use crate::matrix::{ComplexInterval as C, Matrix};
use crate::object::Object;
use crate::rat::{rat_of_json, Interval, Rat};
use num_traits::{One, Signed, Zero};
use std::borrow::Cow;
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, HashMap, HashSet};

pub(crate) mod native_model;

type Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, ClaimOutcome>;
fn pending<T>(reason: impl Into<String>) -> Result<T> {
    Err(ClaimOutcome::unchecked(reason))
}
fn invalid<T>(path: &str, reason: impl Into<String>) -> Result<T> {
    Err(ClaimOutcome::rejected(vec![rej(
        "E_SCHEDULE_INFEASIBLE",
        "§11",
        path,
        reason.into(),
    )]))
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Context {
    pub symbol: String,
    pub controls: u64,
    pub invocation: Invocation,
    pub key: Vec<Value>,
    pub adjoint: bool,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub(crate) struct Gate {
    pub(crate) op: String,
    pub(crate) own_controls: usize,
    pub(crate) controls: Vec<usize>,
    pub(crate) targets: Vec<usize>,
    pub(crate) path: Vec<Value>,
    generated: u64,
    angle_bits: Option<u64>,
    adjoint: bool,
    template_leaf: bool,
    requested_share: Option<Rat>,
}
fn resolve_angle(text: &str, context: &Context, object: &Object) -> Result<u64> {
    let bad = |message: String| {
        ClaimOutcome::rejected(vec![rej(
            "E_CERT_OBJECT",
            "§3.1/§16.1",
            format!("object.@{}", context.symbol),
            message,
        )])
    };
    let f = object
        .function(&context.symbol)
        .expect("expanded function exists");
    let bits =
        if let Some((i, param)) = f.groups[3].iter().enumerate().find(|(_, p)| p.name == text) {
            if param.ty != "f64" {
                return Err(bad(format!(
                    "gate angle argument {text} has type {}, expected f64",
                    param.ty
                )));
            }
            let encoded = context
                .invocation
                .args
                .get(i)
                .and_then(Value::as_str)
                .unwrap_or("");
            if encoded.len() != 18 || !encoded.starts_with("0x") {
                return Err(bad(
                    "angle argument is not a bound binary64 bit pattern".into()
                ));
            }
            u64::from_str_radix(&encoded[2..], 16)
                .map_err(|_| bad("invalid binary64 angle argument".into()))?
        } else {
            let value = text.parse::<f64>().map_err(|_| {
                bad(format!(
                    "gate angle {text:?} is not a finite canonical FLOAT or bound f64 argument"
                ))
            })?;
            if !value.is_finite() {
                return Err(bad("gate angle is NaN or infinite".into()));
            }
            let mut spelling = if value == 0.0 && value.is_sign_negative() {
                "-0.0".to_string()
            } else {
                crate::json::ecmascript_number(value)
            };
            if !spelling.contains(['.', 'e']) {
                spelling.push_str(".0");
            }
            if text != spelling {
                return Err(bad(format!(
                    "noncanonical gate angle {text:?}; expected {spelling:?}"
                )));
            }
            value.to_bits()
        };
    crate::transcendental::binary64_rational(bits).map_err(bad)?;
    Ok(bits)
}
impl Gate {
    /// §5.3 replaces a primitive by its adjoint before target matching and
    /// leaf accounting. A native T entry does not implement T-dagger.
    pub(crate) fn realised_opcode(&self) -> &str {
        if !self.adjoint {
            return &self.op;
        }
        match self.op.as_str() {
            "s" => "sdg",
            "sdg" => "s",
            "t" => "tdg",
            "tdg" => "t",
            _ => &self.op,
        }
    }
}
fn element(hash: &str, block: &str, ordinal: usize, iteration: &[u64]) -> Value {
    Value::Obj(BTreeMap::from([
        ("symbol".into(), s(hash)),
        ("point".into(), s(&format!("{block}:{ordinal}"))),
        (
            "iteration".into(),
            Value::Arr(iteration.iter().map(n).collect()),
        ),
        ("instance".into(), Value::Arr(vec![])),
        ("call_index".into(), n(0)),
    ]))
}

struct SourceRow {
    tokens: Vec<String>,
    block: String,
    ordinal: usize,
    iteration: Vec<u64>,
    generated: u64,
}
fn static_size(stmts: &[Stmt]) -> usize {
    stmts
        .iter()
        .map(|stmt| match stmt {
            Stmt::Line(_) | Stmt::SelectorFlip(_) => 1,
            Stmt::SelectorGuard(_, _) => 0,
            Stmt::Block { body, rest, .. } => {
                1 + static_size(body) + rest.as_ref().map(|r| static_size(r)).unwrap_or(0)
            }
        })
        .sum()
}
fn loop_bounds(stmts: &[Stmt], bounds: &mut Vec<u64>) -> Result<()> {
    for stmt in stmts {
        if let Stmt::Block { head, body, rest } = stmt {
            if head.first().map(String::as_str) == Some("qloop") {
                let n = head
                    .get(1)
                    .and_then(|x| x.parse::<u64>().ok())
                    .ok_or_else(|| {
                        ClaimOutcome::unchecked("qloop count exceeds this host's integer range")
                    })?;
                bounds.push(n);
            }
            loop_bounds(body, bounds)?;
            if let Some(rest) = rest {
                loop_bounds(rest, bounds)?;
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}
fn emit_row(
    tokens: Vec<String>,
    block: &str,
    ordinal: usize,
    iteration: &[u64],
    generated: u64,
    rows: &mut Vec<SourceRow>,
    max: u64,
) -> Result<()> {
    if rows.len() as u64 >= max.min(100_000) {
        return Err(host_limit_outcome(HostLimit {
            quantity: "expanded source row count exceeds host work/storage limit".into(),
        }));
    }
    rows.push(SourceRow {
        tokens,
        block: block.into(),
        ordinal,
        iteration: iteration.to_vec(),
        generated,
    });
    Ok(())
}
fn expand_rows(
    stmts: &[Stmt],
    block: &str,
    mut ordinal: usize,
    iteration: &mut Vec<u64>,
    rows: &mut Vec<SourceRow>,
    max: u64,
) -> Result<()> {
    if iteration.len() > 64 {
        return Err(host_limit_outcome(HostLimit {
            quantity: "qloop nesting exceeds 64 host levels".into(),
        }));
    }
    for stmt in stmts {
        match stmt {
            Stmt::SelectorFlip(_)|Stmt::SelectorGuard(_,_)=>return pending("internal reference adjoint node cannot serve as a source expansion point"),
            Stmt::Line(tokens)=>emit_row(tokens.clone(),block,ordinal,iteration,0,rows,max)?,
            Stmt::Block{head,body,rest}=>match head.first().map(String::as_str) {
                Some("qloop") if head.len()==2 && rest.is_none()=>{
                    let count=head[1].parse::<u64>().map_err(|_|host_limit_outcome(HostLimit{quantity:"qloop count exceeds host integer range".into()}))?;
                    if !body.is_empty() {
                        if count>max.min(100_000) {return Err(host_limit_outcome(HostLimit{quantity:"qloop visits exceed host work limit".into()}));}
                        for i in 0..count {
                            iteration.push(i);expand_rows(body,block,ordinal+1,iteration,rows,max)?;iteration.pop();
                        }
                    }
                },
                Some("qif") if head.len()==2=>{
                    let p=&head[1];
                    emit_row(vec!["qpred".into(),p.clone()],block,ordinal,iteration,0,rows,max)?;
                    expand_rows(body,block,ordinal+1,iteration,rows,max)?;
                    emit_row(vec!["qunpred".into(),p.clone()],block,ordinal,iteration,0,rows,max)?;
                    emit_row(vec!["x".into(),p.clone()],block,ordinal,iteration,0,rows,max)?;
                    emit_row(vec!["qpred".into(),p.clone()],block,ordinal,iteration,0,rows,max)?;
                    if let Some(rest)=rest {expand_rows(rest,block,ordinal+1+static_size(body),iteration,rows,max)?;}
                    emit_row(vec!["qunpred".into(),p.clone()],block,ordinal,iteration,0,rows,max)?;
                    emit_row(vec!["x".into(),p.clone()],block,ordinal,iteration,1,rows,max)?;
                },
                _=>return pending("structured form requires its complete coherent control and unconditional lifetime expansion"),
            },
        }
        ordinal += match stmt {
            Stmt::Line(_) | Stmt::SelectorFlip(_) => 1,
            Stmt::SelectorGuard(_, _) => 0,
            Stmt::Block { body, rest, .. } => {
                1 + static_size(body) + rest.as_ref().map(|r| static_size(r)).unwrap_or(0)
            }
        };
    }
    Ok(())
}
fn prefixes<'a>(
    mut tokens: &'a [String],
    controls: &mut Vec<usize>,
    wires: &HashMap<String, Vec<usize>>,
    adjoint: &mut bool,
) -> Result<&'a [String]> {
    loop {
        match tokens.first().map(String::as_str) {
            Some("ctl") => {
                let wire = tokens
                    .get(1)
                    .ok_or_else(|| ClaimOutcome::unchecked("ctl without wire"))?;
                controls.push(one_wire(wire, wires)?);
                tokens = &tokens[2..];
            }
            Some("adj") => {
                *adjoint = !*adjoint;
                tokens = &tokens[1..];
            }
            _ => return Ok(tokens),
        }
    }
}
fn bundle(name: &str, wires: &HashMap<String, Vec<usize>>) -> Result<Vec<usize>> {
    if let Some((name, index)) = name.strip_suffix(']').and_then(|s| s.split_once('[')) {
        let index = crate::eval::literal_wire_index(index).ok_or_else(|| {
            ClaimOutcome::rejected(vec![rej(
                "E_CERT_OBJECT",
                "§3.3",
                "object",
                "wire subscript is not a canonical in-range nonnegative integer",
            )])
        })?;
        return wires
            .get(name)
            .and_then(|b| b.get(index))
            .map(|i| vec![*i])
            .ok_or_else(|| {
                ClaimOutcome::rejected(vec![rej(
                    "E_CERT_OBJECT",
                    "§3.3",
                    "object",
                    "wire subscript out of range",
                )])
            });
    }
    wires.get(name).cloned().ok_or_else(|| {
        ClaimOutcome::rejected(vec![rej(
            "E_CERT_OBJECT",
            "§3.3",
            "object",
            format!("wire {name:?} is not live"),
        )])
    })
}
fn one_wire(name: &str, wires: &HashMap<String, Vec<usize>>) -> Result<usize> {
    let b = bundle(name, wires)?;
    if b.len() != 1 {
        return Err(ClaimOutcome::rejected(vec![rej(
            "E_CERT_OBJECT",
            "§4.4 K93",
            "object",
            format!("expected exactly one wire, got {name:?}"),
        )]));
    }
    Ok(b[0])
}
fn child_invocation(tokens: &[String], parent: &Context, object: &Object) -> Result<Invocation> {
    let f = object
        .function(&parent.symbol)
        .ok_or_else(|| ClaimOutcome::unchecked("parent action has no body"))?;
    let arg_values: HashMap<&str, &Value> = f.groups[3]
        .iter()
        .zip(&parent.invocation.args)
        .map(|(p, v)| (p.name.as_str(), v))
        .collect();
    let args = list_items(tokens.get(5).map(String::as_str).unwrap_or("()"));
    let token_origins: HashMap<_, _> = f.groups[3]
        .iter()
        .filter(|p| p.ty == "token")
        .zip(&parent.invocation.token_aliases)
        .map(|(p, id)| (p.name.as_str(), *id))
        .collect();
    let mut alias_classes = HashMap::new();
    let mut aliases = Vec::new();
    let mut resolved = Vec::new();
    for name in args {
        if let Some(id) = token_origins.get(name.as_str()) {
            let next = alias_classes.len() as u64;
            let label = *alias_classes.entry(*id).or_insert(next);
            aliases.push(n(label));
        }
        resolved.push(
            arg_values
                .get(name.as_str())
                .map(|v| (*v).clone())
                .ok_or_else(|| {
                    ClaimOutcome::unchecked(format!(
                        "unresolved classical action-call argument {name:?}"
                    ))
                })?,
        );
    }
    let callee = tokens
        .get(1)
        .map(|s| s.trim_start_matches('@'))
        .unwrap_or("");
    let iface = object.interface(callee).map_err(ClaimOutcome::unchecked)?;
    let value = Value::Obj(BTreeMap::from([
        ("args".into(), Value::Arr(resolved)),
        ("token_aliases".into(), Value::Arr(aliases)),
        (
            "budget".into(),
            Value::Arr(
                parent
                    .invocation
                    .budget
                    .iter()
                    .map(|b| s(&b.to_string()))
                    .collect(),
            ),
        ),
    ]));
    parse_invocation(&value, &iface.args, object, "resolved invocation")
        .map_err(ClaimOutcome::rejected)
}
fn collect(
    context: &Context,
    object: &Object,
    wires: HashMap<String, Vec<usize>>,
    inherited: Vec<usize>,
    contexts: &mut Vec<Context>,
    gates: &mut Vec<Gate>,
    max: u64,
    depth: usize,
) -> Result<()> {
    if depth > 64 || contexts.len() as u64 >= max || gates.len() as u64 >= max {
        return Err(host_limit_outcome(HostLimit {
            quantity: "native action invocation/gate expansion limit".into(),
        }));
    }
    contexts.push(context.clone());
    let f = object
        .function(&context.symbol)
        .ok_or_else(|| ClaimOutcome::unchecked("action context has no body"))?;
    if !matches!(f.kind.as_str(), "action" | "perm_action") {
        return pending(format!(
            "§11.1 expansion of {} @{} is not implemented by the native matrix builder",
            f.kind, f.name
        ));
    }
    let blocks = parse_blocks(f);
    let mut bounds = Vec::new();
    for (_, stmts) in &blocks {
        loop_bounds(stmts, &mut bounds)?;
    }
    if bounds != f.bounds {
        return Err(ClaimOutcome::rejected(vec![rej(
            "E_CERT_OBJECT",
            "§5.3",
            format!("object.@{}.bounds", f.name),
            "declared bounds do not equal the static qloop counts in text order",
        )]));
    }
    let mut rows = Vec::new();
    for (block, stmts) in &blocks {
        expand_rows(stmts, block, 0, &mut Vec::new(), &mut rows, max)?;
    }
    let hash = object
        .symbol(&context.symbol)
        .and_then(|s| s.closure_hash.as_deref())
        .ok_or_else(|| ClaimOutcome::unchecked("context symbol has no closure identity"))?;
    let mut predicates = inherited;
    let mut body_gates = Vec::new();
    for row in rows {
        if gates.len() + body_gates.len() > max as usize {
            return Err(host_limit_outcome(HostLimit {
                quantity: "native gate expansion limit".into(),
            }));
        }
        let tokens = row.tokens;
        let mut controls = predicates.clone();
        let mut adjoint = false;
        let tokens = prefixes(&tokens, &mut controls, &wires, &mut adjoint)?;
        // §2 defines the effective context as a set, even when an inherited
        // control, local predicate and ctl prefix name the same wire. Keep
        // its outermost occurrence for §8.3's control ordering. The raw stack
        // below still retains every push so qunpred remains LIFO checked.
        let mut seen = HashSet::new();
        controls.retain(|wire| seen.insert(*wire));
        let op = tokens.first().map(String::as_str).unwrap_or("");
        let mut path = context.key.clone();
        path.push(element(hash, &row.block, row.ordinal, &row.iteration));
        match op {
            "qpred" => {
                predicates.push(one_wire(
                    tokens.get(1).map(String::as_str).unwrap_or(""),
                    &wires,
                )?);
            }
            "qunpred" => {
                if predicates.len() <= context.controls as usize {
                    return invalid("object", "qunpred cannot pop an inherited predicate");
                }
                let bit = one_wire(tokens.get(1).map(String::as_str).unwrap_or(""), &wires)?;
                if predicates.pop() != Some(bit) {
                    return invalid("object", "unbalanced predicate stack");
                }
            }
            "action_call" => {
                let name = tokens
                    .get(1)
                    .map(|s| s.trim_start_matches('@'))
                    .unwrap_or("")
                    .to_string();
                let iface = object.interface(&name).map_err(ClaimOutcome::unchecked)?;
                if !iface.regions.is_empty() || !iface.borrowed_widths.is_empty() {
                    return pending("nested regions/borrow lifetimes need expansion before native matrix construction");
                }
                let actuals: Vec<String> = [2, 3]
                    .iter()
                    .flat_map(|i| list_items(tokens.get(*i).map(String::as_str).unwrap_or("()")))
                    .collect();
                if actuals.len() != iface.bundles.len() {
                    return invalid("object", "action-call operand count differs from signature");
                }
                let mut child_wires = HashMap::new();
                for (b, a) in iface.bundles.iter().zip(actuals) {
                    let actual = bundle(&a, &wires)?;
                    if actual.len() != b.width as usize {
                        return invalid(
                            "object",
                            "action-call bundle width differs from signature",
                        );
                    }
                    child_wires.insert(b.name.clone(), actual);
                }
                let child = Context {
                    symbol: name,
                    controls: controls.len() as u64,
                    invocation: child_invocation(tokens, context, object)?,
                    key: path,
                    adjoint: adjoint ^ context.adjoint,
                };
                let mut nested_gates = Vec::new();
                collect(
                    &child,
                    object,
                    child_wires,
                    controls,
                    contexts,
                    &mut nested_gates,
                    max,
                    depth + 1,
                )?;
                // The enclosing adjoint is applied to this complete body's
                // stream below. Child context identity already includes it;
                // undo that part here to avoid applying it twice to leaves.
                if context.adjoint {
                    nested_gates.reverse();
                    for g in &mut nested_gates {
                        g.adjoint = !g.adjoint;
                    }
                }
                body_gates.extend(nested_gates);
            }
            "x" | "cx" | "ccx" | "mcx" | "swap" | "h" | "s" | "sdg" | "t" | "tdg" | "cz" | "rx"
            | "ry" | "rz" => {
                if f.kind == "perm_action" && !matches!(op, "x" | "cx" | "ccx" | "mcx" | "swap") {
                    return Err(ClaimOutcome::rejected(vec![rej(
                        "E_CERT_OBJECT",
                        "§5.3",
                        format!("object.@{}", f.name),
                        "perm_action contains a nonpermutation primitive",
                    )]));
                }
                let arity = match op {
                    "cx" | "mcx" | "swap" | "cz" | "rx" | "ry" | "rz" => 3,
                    "ccx" => 4,
                    _ => 2,
                };
                if tokens.len() != arity {
                    return invalid(
                        "object",
                        format!("gate {op} has the wrong number of operands"),
                    );
                }
                let operands = &tokens[1..];
                let angle_bits = if matches!(op, "rx" | "ry" | "rz") {
                    Some(resolve_angle(&operands[0], context, object)?)
                } else {
                    None
                };
                let inherited_count = controls.len();
                let targets = match op {
                    "cx" => {
                        controls.push(one_wire(
                            operands.first().map(String::as_str).unwrap_or(""),
                            &wires,
                        )?);
                        vec![one_wire(
                            operands.get(1).map(String::as_str).unwrap_or(""),
                            &wires,
                        )?]
                    }
                    "ccx" => {
                        for operand in operands.iter().take(2) {
                            controls.push(one_wire(operand, &wires)?);
                        }
                        vec![one_wire(
                            operands.get(2).map(String::as_str).unwrap_or(""),
                            &wires,
                        )?]
                    }
                    "mcx" => {
                        let entries =
                            crate::eval::canonical_list(&operands[0]).ok_or_else(|| {
                                ClaimOutcome::rejected(vec![rej(
                                    "E_CERT_OBJECT",
                                    "§4.4 K93",
                                    "object",
                                    "MCX controls require a canonical parenthesised list",
                                )])
                            })?;
                        let mut distinct = controls.iter().copied().collect::<HashSet<_>>();
                        for operand in entries {
                            for wire in bundle(&operand, &wires)? {
                                if !distinct.insert(wire) {
                                    return Err(ClaimOutcome::rejected(vec![rej("E_CERT_OBJECT", "§4.4 K93", "object", "flattened MCX controls repeat or overlap the effective context")]));
                                }
                                controls.push(wire);
                            }
                        }
                        vec![one_wire(
                            operands.get(1).map(String::as_str).unwrap_or(""),
                            &wires,
                        )?]
                    }
                    "swap" | "cz" => operands
                        .iter()
                        .map(|t| one_wire(t, &wires))
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?,
                    "rx" | "ry" | "rz" => vec![one_wire(&operands[1], &wires)?],
                    _ => vec![one_wire(
                        operands.first().map(String::as_str).unwrap_or(""),
                        &wires,
                    )?],
                };
                let mut all = controls.clone();
                all.extend(&targets);
                let unique: HashSet<usize> = all.iter().copied().collect();
                if all.len() != unique.len() {
                    return Err(ClaimOutcome::rejected(vec![rej(
                        "E_CERT_OBJECT",
                        "§3.3/§4.4",
                        "object",
                        "gate controls and targets are not disjoint",
                    )]));
                }
                body_gates.push(Gate {
                    op: op.into(),
                    own_controls: controls.len() - inherited_count,
                    controls,
                    targets,
                    path,
                    angle_bits,
                    generated: row.generated,
                    adjoint,
                    template_leaf: false,
                    requested_share: None,
                });
            }
            _ => {
                return pending(format!(
                "native matrix expansion of @{hash} instruction {op:?} has not been implemented"
            ))
            }
        }
    }
    if predicates.len() != context.controls as usize {
        return invalid("object", "predicate stack is not restored at action exit");
    }
    if context.adjoint {
        body_gates.reverse();
        for gate in &mut body_gates {
            gate.adjoint = !gate.adjoint;
        }
    }
    gates.extend(body_gates);
    Ok(())
}
fn root_wires(context: &Context, object: &Object) -> Result<HashMap<String, Vec<usize>>> {
    let iface = object
        .interface(&context.symbol)
        .map_err(ClaimOutcome::unchecked)?;
    if !iface.regions.is_empty() || !iface.borrowed_widths.is_empty() {
        return pending(
            "native matrix builder needs region/borrow lifetime expansion for this subject",
        );
    }
    let mut next = context.controls as usize;
    let mut wires = HashMap::new();
    for b in iface.bundles {
        let end = next.checked_add(b.width as usize).ok_or_else(|| {
            host_limit_outcome(HostLimit {
                quantity: "native wire allocation".into(),
            })
        })?;
        wires.insert(b.name, (next..end).collect());
        next = end;
    }
    Ok(wires)
}
pub(crate) fn trace(docs: &LoadedDocs, inputs: &Inputs) -> Result<(Vec<Context>, Vec<Gate>)> {
    let schedule = docs
        .schedule
        .as_ref()
        .ok_or_else(|| ClaimOutcome::unchecked("schedule document is missing"))?;
    if docs.expansion_unknown {
        return pending("bound expansion library is not implemented");
    }
    // The source trace expands adjoints as reverse cleanup. A recompute
    // decision changes that expansion and its timing/resources; using the
    // reverse trace would discharge obligations about a different circuit.
    if schedule
        .get("entries")
        .and_then(Value::as_arr)
        .unwrap_or(&[])
        .iter()
        .any(|entry| {
            entry.get("kind").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some("cleanup")
                && entry
                    .get("cleanup")
                    .and_then(|c| c.get("realisation"))
                    .and_then(Value::as_str)
                    == Some("recompute")
        })
    {
        return pending("recompute cleanup expansion and its scheduled resources have not been independently derived (§11/§12.3)");
    }
    let root = docs
        .object
        .symbol_by_closure(&docs.root_closure)
        .ok_or_else(|| ClaimOutcome::unchecked("root closure is not linked"))?;
    let invocation = docs
        .root_invocation
        .clone()
        .ok_or_else(|| ClaimOutcome::unchecked("root invocation is unavailable"))?;
    let controls = schedule
        .get("bindings")
        .and_then(|b| b.get("inherited_controls"))
        .and_then(u64_of)
        .unwrap_or(0);
    let context = Context {
        symbol: root.name.clone(),
        controls,
        invocation,
        key: vec![],
        adjoint: false,
    };
    // Bound before materialising any wire vector.
    check_width(&context, docs, inputs, false)?;
    let mut contexts = Vec::new();
    let mut gates = Vec::new();
    collect(
        &context,
        &docs.object,
        root_wires(&context, &docs.object)?,
        (0..controls as usize).collect(),
        &mut contexts,
        &mut gates,
        inputs.limits.max_elements,
        0,
    )?;
    contexts
        .sort_by_key(|c| jcs(&Value::Arr(c.key.clone())).expect("concrete context key is JSON"));
    Ok((contexts, gates))
}
/// Source reference gates, without any target, schedule, or producer reports.
pub(crate) fn reference_gates(object: &Object, context: &Context, max: u64) -> Result<Vec<Gate>> {
    let mut gates = Vec::new();
    collect(
        context,
        object,
        root_wires(context, object)?,
        (0..context.controls as usize).collect(),
        &mut Vec::new(),
        &mut gates,
        max,
        0,
    )?;
    Ok(gates)
}
pub fn contexts(docs: &LoadedDocs, inputs: &Inputs) -> Result<Vec<Context>> {
    trace(docs, inputs).map(|(contexts, _)| contexts)
}
fn check_width(c: &Context, docs: &LoadedDocs, inputs: &Inputs, dense: bool) -> Result<usize> {
    let iface = docs
        .object
        .interface(&c.symbol)
        .map_err(ClaimOutcome::unchecked)?;
    let width = iface
        .bundles
        .iter()
        .try_fold(c.controls, |sum, b| sum.checked_add(b.width))
        .ok_or_else(|| {
            host_limit_outcome(HostLimit {
                quantity: "unitary wire count overflow".into(),
            })
        })?;
    // Dense cubic rational matrix multiplication is bounded separately from
    // legal ISA widths. No host cap is a domain rejection.
    if dense && width > u64::from(inputs.limits.max_wires.min(6)) {
        return Err(host_limit_outcome(HostLimit {
            quantity: format!(
                "dense unitary requires {width} wires (host cap {})",
                inputs.limits.max_wires.min(6)
            ),
        }));
    }
    if !dense && width > inputs.limits.max_elements.min(1 << 20) {
        return Err(host_limit_outcome(HostLimit {
            quantity: format!(
                "native event trace requires {width} wire identities (host cap {})",
                inputs.limits.max_elements.min(1 << 20)
            ),
        }));
    }
    Ok(width as usize)
}
fn selector(entry: &Value, path: &[Value], generated: u64) -> bool {
    let Some(p) = entry.get("path").and_then(Value::as_arr) else {
        return false;
    };
    if p.len() > path.len()
        || entry.get("step").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some("*")
        || entry.get("phase").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some("*")
    {
        return false;
    }
    if entry.get("generated").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some("*")
        && entry.get("generated").and_then(u64_of) != Some(generated)
    {
        return false;
    }
    p.iter().zip(path).all(|(want, got)| {
        if want.get("symbol") != got.get("symbol") || want.get("point") != got.get("point") {
            return false;
        }
        for key in ["iteration", "instance"] {
            if let Some(v) = want.get(key) {
                if v.as_str() != Some("*") && got.get(key) != Some(v) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        want.get("call_index")
            .map(|v| v.as_str() == Some("*") || u64_of(v) == Some(0))
            .unwrap_or(true)
    })
}
pub(crate) fn decision_kind<'a>(
    docs: &'a LoadedDocs,
    gate: &Gate,
    kind: &str,
) -> Result<Option<&'a Value>> {
    let entries = docs
        .schedule
        .as_ref()
        .and_then(|s| s.get("entries"))
        .and_then(Value::as_arr)
        .unwrap_or(&[]);
    let mut best: Option<((usize, usize, u8, u8, u8), &Value)> = None;
    let mut tied = false;
    for entry in entries {
        if entry.get("kind").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some(kind)
            || !selector(entry, &gate.path, gate.generated)
        {
            continue;
        }
        let p = entry.get("path").and_then(Value::as_arr).unwrap();
        let specificity = (
            p.len(),
            p.iter()
                .filter(|e| e.get("iteration").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some("*"))
                .count(),
            0,
            0,
            u8::from(entry.get("generated").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some("*")),
        );
        if best.as_ref().map(|(s, _)| specificity > *s).unwrap_or(true) {
            best = Some((specificity, entry));
            tied = false;
        } else if best
            .as_ref()
            .map(|(s, _)| specificity == *s)
            .unwrap_or(false)
        {
            tied = true;
        }
    }
    if tied {
        return invalid(
            "schedule.entries",
            format!("two matching {kind} decisions have equal maximal specificity"),
        );
    }
    Ok(best.and_then(|(_, e)| e.get(kind)))
}
fn integer_cmp(value: &Value, count: u64) -> Option<std::cmp::Ordering> {
    if let Some(value) = u64_of(value) {
        return Some(value.cmp(&count));
    }
    let text = value
        .as_str()
        .filter(|s| crate::rat::is_canonical_uint_str(s))?;
    let actual = count.to_string();
    Some(
        text.len()
            .cmp(&actual.len())
            .then_with(|| text.cmp(&actual)),
    )
}
fn control_range(entry: &Value, count: u64) -> bool {
    let controls = entry.get("controls");
    controls
        .and_then(|c| c.get("min"))
        .and_then(|v| integer_cmp(v, count))
        .map(|o| o != std::cmp::Ordering::Greater)
        == Some(true)
        && controls.and_then(|c| c.get("max")).map(|v| {
            v.as_str() == Some("unbounded")
                || integer_cmp(v, count).map(|o| o != std::cmp::Ordering::Less) == Some(true)
        }) == Some(true)
}
fn scheme_covers(scheme: &Value, gate: &Gate) -> bool {
    scheme.get("realises").map(|r| {
        r.get("op").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some(gate.realised_opcode())
            && control_range(r, gate.controls.len() as u64)
            && parameters_cover(r, gate)
    }) == Some(true)
}
fn parameters_cover(entry: &Value, gate: &Gate) -> bool {
    let params = entry.get("params").and_then(Value::as_arr).unwrap_or(&[]);
    if gate.angle_bits.is_some() {
        params.len() == 1 && params[0].as_str() == Some("theta")
    } else {
        params.is_empty()
    }
}
enum Choice<'a> {
    Native(&'a Value),
    Scheme(&'a Value),
}
fn native_numbers(
    docs: &LoadedDocs,
    gate: &Gate,
    entry: &Value,
) -> Result<(HashMap<&'static str, Rat>, Rat, Option<Rat>)> {
    let target = docs.target.as_ref().expect("native target is present");
    let decision = if gate.template_leaf {
        None
    } else {
        decision_kind(docs, gate, "gate")?
    };
    let mut vars = HashMap::from([
        ("k", Rat::from_integer(gate.own_controls.into())),
        ("c", Rat::from_integer(gate.controls.len().into())),
    ]);
    let epsilon = entry
        .get("epsilon")
        .expect("target schema validated epsilon");
    let share = gate
        .requested_share
        .clone()
        .or_else(|| {
            decision
                .and_then(|g| g.get("epsilon_share"))
                .and_then(|e| rat_of_json(e).ok())
        })
        .or_else(|| {
            docs.schedule
                .as_ref()
                .and_then(|s| s.get("bindings"))
                .and_then(|b| b.get("epsilon"))
                .and_then(|e| rat_of_json(e).ok())
                .filter(|e| e.is_zero())
        });
    if let Some(share) = &share {
        vars.insert("eps", share.clone());
    } else if crate::expressions::uses_epsilon(epsilon) {
        return pending("default epsilon shares require counting all approximate operations before native matching");
    }
    let achieved =
        crate::expressions::evaluate(epsilon, &vars, target.get("tables").unwrap_or(&Value::Null))
            .map_err(|error| match error {
                crate::expressions::Error::Invalid(message) => ClaimOutcome::rejected(vec![rej(
                    "E_CERT_TARGET",
                    "§8.1",
                    "target.gates.epsilon",
                    message,
                )]),
                crate::expressions::Error::HostLimit(limit) => host_limit_outcome(limit),
            })?;
    if achieved.is_negative() {
        return Err(ClaimOutcome::rejected(vec![rej(
            "E_CERT_TARGET",
            "§8.1",
            "target.gates.epsilon",
            "evaluated native epsilon must be nonnegative",
        )]));
    }
    Ok((vars, achieved, share))
}
fn select<'a>(docs: &'a LoadedDocs, gate: &Gate) -> Result<Choice<'a>> {
    let target = docs
        .target
        .as_ref()
        .ok_or_else(|| ClaimOutcome::unchecked("target document is missing"))?;
    if target.get("topology").is_some() {
        return pending("native topology/placement validation has not been implemented");
    }
    let classes = target
        .get("classes")
        .and_then(Value::as_obj)
        .ok_or_else(|| ClaimOutcome::unchecked("target classes unavailable"))?;
    if classes.len() != 1 {
        return pending("native matrix builder needs resolved multi-class allocation");
    }
    let class = classes.keys().next().unwrap();
    let decision = if gate.template_leaf {
        None
    } else {
        decision_kind(docs, gate, "gate")?
    };
    let schemes = target.get("schemes").and_then(Value::as_arr).unwrap_or(&[]);
    if let Some(g) = decision {
        if g.get("realisation").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some("native") {
            let name = g.get("realisation").and_then(Value::as_str);
            if let Some(scheme) = schemes
                .iter()
                .find(|s| s.get("name").and_then(Value::as_str) == name && scheme_covers(s, gate))
            {
                return Ok(Choice::Scheme(scheme));
            }
            return invalid("schedule.gate.realisation","named scheme does not exist or its opcode/control range does not cover the generated gate");
        }
    }
    let gates = target.get("gates").and_then(Value::as_arr).unwrap_or(&[]);
    for entry in gates {
        if entry.get("op").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some(gate.realised_opcode()) {
            continue;
        }
        if !parameters_cover(entry, gate) {
            continue;
        }
        let count = gate.controls.len() as u64;
        if !control_range(entry, count) {
            continue;
        }
        let pattern = entry.get("classes").and_then(Value::as_arr).unwrap_or(&[]);
        if pattern.len() != 1 || !matches!(pattern[0].as_str(),Some(c) if c==class || c=="*") {
            return pending(
                "native class-pattern matching needs a resolved operand-class expansion",
            );
        }
        let (_, achieved, share) = native_numbers(docs, gate, entry)?;
        let epsilon = entry.get("epsilon").unwrap();
        if achieved.is_zero() {
            if crate::expressions::uses_epsilon(epsilon)
                || entry.get("cost").map(crate::expressions::uses_epsilon) == Some(true)
            {
                return Err(ClaimOutcome::rejected(vec![rej(
                    "E_CERT_TARGET",
                    "§8.1",
                    "target.gates",
                    "an exact entry must not reference eps or an epsilon logarithm/index",
                )]));
            }
            return Ok(Choice::Native(entry));
        }
        if share.as_ref().map(|eps| &achieved > eps) == Some(true) {
            continue;
        }
        if share.is_none() {
            return pending(
                "positive native epsilon needs a resolved requested share before matching",
            );
        }
        if entry.get("realisation_model").is_some() {
            return Ok(Choice::Native(entry));
        }
        return pending(
            "positive native epsilon needs a specified realised operator before numerical replay",
        );
    }
    if !gate.template_leaf && decision.is_none() {
        if let Some(scheme) = schemes.iter().find(|s| scheme_covers(s, gate)) {
            return Ok(Choice::Scheme(scheme));
        }
    }
    invalid(
        "target.gates/schemes",
        format!(
            "gate {} with {} total controls has no matching selected native entry or scheme",
            gate.realised_opcode(),
            gate.controls.len()
        ),
    )
}
pub(crate) fn native<'a>(docs: &'a LoadedDocs, gate: &Gate) -> Result<&'a Value> {
    match select(docs, gate)? {
        Choice::Native(entry) => Ok(entry),
        Choice::Scheme(_) => pending("selected scheme needs leaf expansion before native matching"),
    }
}
fn scheme_bad<T>(message: impl AsRef<str>) -> Result<T> {
    Err(ClaimOutcome::rejected(vec![rej(
        "E_CERT_TARGET",
        "§8.3",
        "target.schemes",
        message,
    )]))
}
fn scheme_expr(value: &Value, vars: &HashMap<&str, Rat>, docs: &LoadedDocs) -> Result<Rat> {
    crate::expressions::evaluate(
        value,
        vars,
        docs.target
            .as_ref()
            .and_then(|t| t.get("tables"))
            .unwrap_or(&Value::Null),
    )
    .map_err(|error| match error {
        crate::expressions::Error::Invalid(message) => ClaimOutcome::rejected(vec![rej(
            "E_CERT_TARGET",
            "§8.1",
            "target.schemes",
            message,
        )]),
        crate::expressions::Error::HostLimit(limit) => host_limit_outcome(limit),
    })
}
/// Expand the supported zero-ancilla, nonparametric one-leaf case. The source
/// address remains the schedule selector address; the leaf's own k differs
/// from the source operation's k when an inherited control becomes explicit.
pub(crate) fn realised_leaf<'g>(docs: &LoadedDocs, gate: &'g Gate) -> Result<Cow<'g, Gate>> {
    let scheme = match select(docs, gate)? {
        Choice::Native(_) => return Ok(Cow::Borrowed(gate)),
        Choice::Scheme(scheme) => scheme,
    };
    let mut vars = HashMap::from([
        ("k", Rat::from_integer(gate.own_controls.into())),
        ("c", Rat::from_integer(gate.controls.len().into())),
    ]);
    if let Some(bits) = gate.angle_bits {
        vars.insert(
            "theta",
            crate::transcendental::binary64_rational(bits).map_err(|message| {
                ClaimOutcome::rejected(vec![rej("E_CERT_OBJECT", "§3.1", "object", message)])
            })?,
        );
    }
    let count = scheme_expr(
        scheme
            .get("ancillae")
            .and_then(|a| a.get("count"))
            .expect("validated scheme ancilla count"),
        &vars,
        docs,
    )?;
    if count.is_negative() || !count.is_integer() {
        return scheme_bad("ancilla count must evaluate to a nonnegative integer");
    }
    if !count.is_zero() {
        return pending(
            "scheme ancilla lifetimes, cleanliness and storage descriptors need expansion",
        );
    }
    let template = scheme
        .get("template")
        .and_then(Value::as_arr)
        .expect("validated scheme template");
    if template.len() != 1 {
        return pending(
            "multi-leaf scheme timing and intermediate state expansion has not been implemented",
        );
    }
    let item = &template[0];
    if item.get("repeat").is_some()
        || gate.angle_bits.is_some()
        || item
            .get("params")
            .and_then(Value::as_arr)
            .map(|p| !p.is_empty())
            .unwrap_or(false)
    {
        return pending("scheme repeat/parameter expansion has not been implemented");
    }
    // §8.3 puts own controls before the outermost-first effective context.
    let inherited = gate.controls.len() - gate.own_controls;
    let ordered: Vec<usize> = gate.controls[inherited..]
        .iter()
        .chain(&gate.controls[..inherited])
        .copied()
        .collect();
    let mut wires = Vec::new();
    for value in item
        .get("wires")
        .and_then(Value::as_arr)
        .expect("validated scheme wires")
    {
        let name = value.as_str().expect("validated scheme wire string");
        let wire = match name {
            "t" => gate.targets.first().copied(),
            "t2" => gate.targets.get(1).copied(),
            _ => {
                let Some((kind, index)) = name.strip_suffix(']').and_then(|n| n.split_once('['))
                else {
                    return scheme_bad("invalid template wire");
                };
                let index = if let Some(value) = vars.get(index) {
                    value.clone()
                } else {
                    let value = crate::json::parse(index).map_err(|_| {
                        ClaimOutcome::unchecked(
                            "template subscript expression spelling requires further parsing",
                        )
                    })?;
                    scheme_expr(&value, &vars, docs)?
                };
                if index.is_negative() || !index.is_integer() {
                    return scheme_bad("template wire index must be a nonnegative integer");
                }
                if kind != "c" {
                    return scheme_bad(
                        "template ancilla index exceeds the zero-ancilla allocation",
                    );
                }
                if index >= Rat::from_integer(ordered.len().into()) {
                    return scheme_bad("template control index is out of range");
                }
                Some(
                    ordered[index
                        .to_integer()
                        .to_string()
                        .parse::<usize>()
                        .expect("index bounded by control vector")],
                )
            }
        };
        wires.push(wire.ok_or_else(|| {
            ClaimOutcome::rejected(vec![rej(
                "E_CERT_TARGET",
                "§8.3",
                "target.schemes",
                "template target does not exist",
            )])
        })?);
    }
    if wires.iter().copied().collect::<HashSet<_>>().len() != wires.len() {
        return scheme_bad("template gate operands are not disjoint");
    }
    let op = item
        .get("gate")
        .and_then(Value::as_str)
        .expect("validated scheme gate");
    let (own, targets) = match op {
        "x" | "h" | "s" | "sdg" | "t" | "tdg" if wires.len() == 1 => (0, 1),
        "cx" if wires.len() == 2 => (1, 1),
        "ccx" if wires.len() == 3 => (2, 1),
        "mcx" if !wires.is_empty() => (wires.len() - 1, 1),
        "swap" | "cz" if wires.len() == 2 => (0, 2),
        _ => {
            return scheme_bad(
                "template primitive has an invalid arity or needs parameter expansion",
            )
        }
    };
    let decision = decision_kind(docs, gate, "gate")?;
    let leaf = Gate {
        op: op.into(),
        own_controls: own,
        controls: wires[..own].to_vec(),
        targets: wires[own..own + targets].to_vec(),
        path: gate.path.clone(),
        generated: gate.generated,
        adjoint: false,
        angle_bits: None,
        template_leaf: true,
        requested_share: decision
            .and_then(|d| d.get("epsilon_share"))
            .and_then(|v| rat_of_json(v).ok()),
    };
    // A one-leaf exact scheme must implement the advertised ideal operator.
    // Normalize the X family and symmetric two-wire primitives from §4.4.
    let identity = |g: &Gate| {
        let op = match g.realised_opcode() {
            "x" | "cx" | "ccx" | "mcx" => "x",
            op => op,
        }
        .to_string();
        let mut controls = g.controls.clone();
        controls.sort_unstable();
        let mut targets = g.targets.clone();
        if matches!(op.as_str(), "swap" | "cz") {
            targets.sort_unstable();
        }
        (op, controls, targets)
    };
    if identity(gate) != identity(&leaf) {
        return scheme_bad(
            "single exact template leaf does not implement its advertised source operator",
        );
    }
    native(docs, &leaf)?; // A template gate must match a native entry; no nesting.
    Ok(Cow::Owned(leaf))
}
fn gate_matrix(g: &Gate, wires: usize, p: u32) -> Result<Matrix> {
    let dim = 1usize << wires;
    let mut m = Matrix::identity(dim);
    let one = C::real(Rat::one());
    let on = |i: usize| g.controls.iter().all(|b| i & (1usize << b) != 0);
    let target = g.targets[0];
    match g.op.as_str() {
        "x" | "cx" | "ccx" | "mcx" | "swap" => {
            m = Matrix::zeros(dim);
            for i in 0..dim {
                let j = if !on(i) {
                    i
                } else if g.op == "swap" {
                    let a = 1usize << g.targets[0];
                    let b = 1usize << g.targets[1];
                    if (i & a != 0) != (i & b != 0) {
                        i ^ a ^ b
                    } else {
                        i
                    }
                } else {
                    i ^ (1usize << target)
                };
                m.set(j, i, one.clone());
            }
        }
        "h" => {
            let half = Interval::exact(Rat::new(1.into(), 2.into()))
                .sqrt(p)
                .unwrap();
            for i in 0..dim {
                if on(i) && i & (1usize << target) == 0 {
                    let j = i | (1usize << target);
                    let h = C {
                        re: half.clone(),
                        im: Interval::exact(Rat::zero()),
                    };
                    m.set(i, i, h.clone());
                    m.set(j, i, h.clone());
                    m.set(i, j, h.clone());
                    m.set(
                        j,
                        j,
                        C {
                            re: h.re.neg(),
                            im: h.im,
                        },
                    );
                }
            }
        }
        "s" | "sdg" | "t" | "tdg" => {
            let negative = matches!(g.op.as_str(), "sdg" | "tdg") ^ g.adjoint;
            let (re, im) = if matches!(g.op.as_str(), "s" | "sdg") {
                (Interval::exact(Rat::zero()), Interval::exact(Rat::one()))
            } else {
                let half = Interval::exact(Rat::new(1.into(), 2.into()))
                    .sqrt(p)
                    .unwrap();
                (half.clone(), half)
            };
            let phase = C {
                re,
                im: if negative { im.neg() } else { im },
            };
            for i in 0..dim {
                if on(i) && i & (1usize << target) != 0 {
                    m.set(i, i, phase.clone());
                }
            }
        }
        "cz" => {
            for i in 0..dim {
                if on(i) && g.targets.iter().all(|b| i & (1usize << b) != 0) {
                    m.set(i, i, C::real(-Rat::one()));
                }
            }
        }
        "rx" | "ry" | "rz" => {
            let bits = g.angle_bits.expect("rotation angle resolved")
                ^ if g.adjoint { 1u64 << 63 } else { 0 };
            let angle = crate::transcendental::binary64_rational(bits)
                .expect("finite angle checked")
                / Rat::from_integer(2.into());
            let (sin, cos) =
                crate::transcendental::sin_cos(&angle, p).map_err(host_limit_outcome)?;
            let real = |re: Interval| C {
                re,
                im: Interval::exact(Rat::zero()),
            };
            for i in 0..dim {
                if on(i) && i & (1usize << target) == 0 {
                    let j = i | (1usize << target);
                    if g.op == "rz" {
                        m.set(
                            i,
                            i,
                            C {
                                re: cos.clone(),
                                im: sin.neg(),
                            },
                        );
                        m.set(
                            j,
                            j,
                            C {
                                re: cos.clone(),
                                im: sin.clone(),
                            },
                        );
                    } else {
                        m.set(i, i, real(cos.clone()));
                        m.set(j, j, real(cos.clone()));
                        if g.op == "rx" {
                            let z = C {
                                re: Interval::exact(Rat::zero()),
                                im: sin.neg(),
                            };
                            m.set(i, j, z.clone());
                            m.set(j, i, z);
                        } else {
                            m.set(i, j, real(sin.neg()));
                            m.set(j, i, real(sin.clone()));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        _ => unreachable!("gate op validated during collection"),
    }
    Ok(m)
}
pub fn subject_matrices(
    subject: &Subject,
    docs: &LoadedDocs,
    inputs: &Inputs,
    p: u32,
) -> Result<Vec<(Context, Matrix, Matrix)>> {
    let contexts = contexts(docs, inputs)?;
    let variant = docs
        .schedule
        .as_ref()
        .and_then(|s| s.get("bindings"))
        .and_then(|b| b.get("variant"))
        .and_then(Value::as_str);
    if variant != Some(subject.variant.as_str()) {
        return invalid(
            "subject.variant",
            "subject variant has no invocation in this root realisation",
        );
    }
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for context in contexts {
        let hash = docs
            .object
            .symbol(&context.symbol)
            .and_then(|s| s.closure_hash.as_deref());
        if hash != Some(subject.closure_hash.as_str())
            || context.controls != subject.inherited_controls
        {
            continue;
        }
        let wires = check_width(&context, docs, inputs, true)?;
        let mut gates = Vec::new();
        collect(
            &context,
            &docs.object,
            root_wires(&context, &docs.object)?,
            (0..context.controls as usize).collect(),
            &mut vec![],
            &mut gates,
            inputs.limits.max_elements,
            0,
        )?;
        let mut reference = Matrix::identity(1 << wires);
        let mut realised = reference.clone();
        if docs.object.symbol(&context.symbol).map(|s| s.kind.as_str()) == Some("perm_action")
            && gates
                .iter()
                .any(|g| !matches!(g.op.as_str(), "x" | "cx" | "ccx" | "mcx" | "swap"))
        {
            return invalid(
                "object",
                "permutation action transitively uses a non-permutation gate (§5.3)",
            );
        }
        for gate in &gates {
            let leaf = realised_leaf(docs, gate)?;
            // Build both matrices from their operation streams. Native exact
            // entries have the §4.4 matrix; schemes must supply expanded leaves.
            let v = gate_matrix(gate, wires, p)?;
            reference = v.mul(&reference, p);
            let u = native_model::matrix(docs, &leaf, wires, p)?;
            realised = u.mul(&realised, p);
        }
        let iface = docs
            .object
            .interface(&context.symbol)
            .map_err(ClaimOutcome::unchecked)?;
        let mut offset = context.controls as usize;
        let mut protected = (1usize << offset) - 1;
        for bundle in &iface.bundles {
            if bundle.group == "in" {
                protected |= ((1usize << bundle.width) - 1) << offset;
            }
            offset += bundle.width as usize;
        }
        for matrix in [&reference, &realised] {
            for row in 0..matrix.dim {
                for col in 0..matrix.dim {
                    if (row ^ col) & protected == 0 {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let z = matrix.get(row, col);
                    if !z.re.contains_zero() || !z.im.contains_zero() {
                        return Err(ClaimOutcome::rejected(vec![rej(
                            "E_CERT_REPLAY",
                            "§5.3",
                            "subject",
                            "unitary changes an input bundle or inherited control",
                        )]));
                    }
                    if !z.re.lo.is_zero()
                        || !z.re.hi.is_zero()
                        || !z.im.lo.is_zero()
                        || !z.im.hi.is_zero()
                    {
                        return pending("interval construction cannot prove preservation of an input bundle or inherited control");
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        out.push((context, realised, reference));
    }
    if out.is_empty() {
        return invalid(
            "subject",
            "subject has no invocation context in the bound realisation",
        );
    }
    Ok(out)
}

/// For a permutation replay, certify that every selected native leaf is
/// exactly the reference gate, with the actual inherited control count.
/// This checks schedule decisions instead of inferring exactness merely
/// from the presence of an unrelated epsilon-zero entry in the target.
pub fn exact_native_subject(subject: &Subject, docs: &LoadedDocs, inputs: &Inputs) -> Result<()> {
    let contexts = contexts(docs, inputs)?;
    let mut found = false;
    for context in contexts {
        let hash = docs
            .object
            .symbol(&context.symbol)
            .and_then(|s| s.closure_hash.as_deref());
        if hash != Some(subject.closure_hash.as_str())
            || context.controls != subject.inherited_controls
        {
            continue;
        }
        found = true;
        let mut gates = vec![];
        collect(
            &context,
            &docs.object,
            root_wires(&context, &docs.object)?,
            (0..context.controls as usize).collect(),
            &mut vec![],
            &mut gates,
            inputs.limits.max_elements,
            0,
        )?;
        for gate in &gates {
            let leaf = realised_leaf(docs, gate)?;
            if native(docs, &leaf)?.get("realisation_model").is_some() {
                let wires = check_width(&context, docs, inputs, true)?;
                let actual = native_model::matrix(docs, &leaf, wires, 128)?;
                if actual != gate_matrix(&leaf, wires, 128)? {
                    return pending("realised table replay for native models differing from their ideal opcode is not implemented");
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if !found {
        return invalid("subject", "subject has no invocation in this schedule");
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod rotation_columns {
    use super::*;
    fn bracket(token: &str) -> (Interval, Interval) {
        let r = |x: &str| crate::rat::parse_decimal(x).unwrap();
        let zero = Interval::exact(Rat::zero());
        let c = Interval {
            lo: r("0.8775825618903727161162815826038296519916"),
            hi: r("0.8775825618903727161162815826038296519917"),
        };
        let s = Interval {
            lo: r("0.4794255386042030002732879352155713880818"),
            hi: r("0.4794255386042030002732879352155713880819"),
        };
        match token {
            "0" => (zero.clone(), zero),
            "1" => (Interval::exact(Rat::one()), zero),
            "c" => (c, zero),
            "s" => (s, zero),
            "-s" => (s.neg(), zero),
            "-is" => (zero, s.neg()),
            "c-is" => (c, s.neg()),
            "c+is" => (c, s),
            _ => unreachable!(),
        }
    }
    #[test]
    fn all_controlled_rotation_columns_match_independent_decimal_brackets_and_adjoint() {
        // These full 4x4 columns pin §4.4's phases/signs and §12.1's control-
        // first order. The constants bracket sin(1/2), cos(1/2) independently.
        for (op, block) in [
            ("rx", [["c", "-is"], ["-is", "c"]]),
            ("ry", [["c", "-s"], ["s", "c"]]),
            ("rz", [["c-is", "0"], ["0", "c+is"]]),
        ] {
            let mut gate = Gate {
                op: op.into(),
                own_controls: 0,
                controls: vec![0],
                targets: vec![1],
                path: vec![],
                angle_bits: Some(1.0f64.to_bits()),
                generated: 0,
                adjoint: false,
                template_leaf: false,
                requested_share: None,
            };
            let forward = gate_matrix(&gate, 2, 128).unwrap();
            for row in 0..4 {
                for col in 0..4 {
                    let token = if col % 2 == 0 {
                        if row == col {
                            "1"
                        } else {
                            "0"
                        }
                    } else if row % 2 == 0 {
                        "0"
                    } else {
                        block[row / 2][col / 2]
                    };
                    let (re, im) = bracket(token);
                    let z = forward.get(row, col);
                    assert!(
                        z.re.lo <= re.lo && z.re.hi >= re.hi,
                        "{op} [{row},{col}] real {z:?}"
                    );
                    assert!(
                        z.im.lo <= im.lo && z.im.hi >= im.hi,
                        "{op} [{row},{col}] imaginary {z:?}"
                    );
                }
            }
            gate.adjoint = true;
            assert_eq!(
                gate_matrix(&gate, 2, 128).unwrap(),
                forward.adjoint(),
                "{op} adjoint"
            );
        }
    }
}

    }
}
````

````rust
use crate::common;
use bennett_cert_checker::cert::{check_certificate, Inputs};
use bennett_cert_checker::json::{jcs, n, Value};
use common::*;
fn change_root(inp: &mut Inputs, f: impl FnOnce(&mut Value)) {
    let mut cert = json(std::str::from_utf8(&inp.cert_bytes).unwrap());
    let hash = cert
        .get("bindings")
        .unwrap()
        .get("closure_hash")
        .unwrap()
        .as_str()
        .unwrap()
        .to_string();
    let Value::Obj(top) = &mut cert else {
        unreachable!()
    };
    let Value::Obj(regions) = top.get_mut("regions").unwrap() else {
        unreachable!()
    };
    f(regions.get_mut(&hash).unwrap());
    inp.cert_bytes = jcs(&cert).unwrap();
}

    assert_eq!(verdict.overall, "verified", "{verdict:?}");
}

#[test]
fn symbolic_source_slot_widths_are_evaluated_at_each_resolved_control_count() {
    let mut inp = controlled();
    let mut cert = json(std::str::from_utf8(&inp.cert_bytes).unwrap());
    let Value::Obj(top) = &mut cert else {
        unreachable!()
    };
    let Value::Obj(regions) = top.get_mut("regions").unwrap() else {
        unreachable!()
    };
    for region in regions.values_mut() {
        let child = region.get("claims").unwrap().as_arr().unwrap().len() == 1;
        let Value::Obj(r) = region else {
            unreachable!()
        };
        let Value::Obj(frame) = r.get_mut("frame").unwrap() else {
            unreachable!()
        };
        let Value::Arr(slots) = frame.get_mut("slots").unwrap() else {
            unreachable!()
        };
        for slot in slots {
            set(
                slot,
                "width",
                json(if child {
                    r#"{"var":"c"}"#
                } else {
                    r#"{"args":[1,{"var":"c"}],"op":"+"}"#
                }),
            );
        }
    }
    inp.cert_bytes = jcs(&cert).unwrap();
    let verdict = check_certificate(&inp);
    assert_eq!(verdict.overall, "verified", "{verdict:?}");
}
````

````rust
use crate::common;
use bennett_cert_checker::{
    domain::Tuple,
    eval::{eval_action_tuple, EvalError},
    object::Object,
};
use common::*;

fn object(body: &str, a: u32, w: u32, t: u32) -> Object {
    object_with_image(body, a, w, t, None)
}
fn object_with_image(body: &str, a: u32, w: u32, t: u32, image: Option<&str>) -> Object {
    let data = image
        .map(|hex| format!("\n\nsection data\nimg {hex}\n\nsection devices\n{{\"models\":{{}},\"services\":{{}}}}"))
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let data_sig = image
        .map(|hex| {
            format!(
                r#", "img":{{"abi":"0.9","kind":"data","size":{},"tier":"-"}}"#,
                hex.len() / 2
            )
        })
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let source=format!("perm_action @a (t:wire[{t}] mut) (c:wire in) (r:region[{a},{w}] mut) () ()\n^entry():\n{body}{data}");
    let sig = format!(
        r#"{{"a":{{"abi":"0.9","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[1],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[{{"A":{a},"W":{w},"role":"mut"}}],"mut":[{t}],"tier":"q"}}{data_sig}}}"#
    );
    let (inputs, _) = standalone(&source, &sig, "a", vec![]);
    let text=rebind_object_symbols(&format!("{}\nsection layout\n{{\"A_tab\":0,\"H\":4,\"S_cells\":0,\"globals\":{{}},\"heap_base\":1,\"heap_limit_max\":0,\"interface_regions\":{{}},\"null_size\":1,\"ptr_width\":32}}\n",inputs.object_text));
    Object::parse(&text).unwrap()
}
fn run(object: &Object, before: &Tuple, adjoint: bool) -> Result<Tuple, EvalError> {
    eval_action_tuple(
        object,
        object.symbol("a").unwrap(),
        &object.interface("a").unwrap(),
        before,
        &[],
        0,
        adjoint,
        0,
    )
}
fn tuple(t: u32, c: u32, cells: &[u32]) -> Tuple {
    Tuple {
        bundles: vec![t.into(), c.into()],
        borrowed: vec![],
        regions: vec![cells.iter().copied().map(Into::into).collect()],
        args: vec![],
    }
}

#[test]
fn memory_width_address_ownership_and_arity_are_checked_before_false_predicates() {
    for body in [
        "qpred c\nqstore r () t\nqunpred c",
        "qpred c\nqexchm r () t\nqunpred c",
        "qpred c\nqunload r () t\nqunpred c",
        "qpred c\nqunload r () ghost\nqunpred c",
        "qpred c\nd = qload r c\nqunload r c d\nqunpred c",
        "qpred c\nd = qload r () ignored\nqunload r () d\nqunpred c",
        "qpred c\nqstore r () c ignored\nqunpred c",
    ] {
        let object = object(body, 0, 1, 2);
        let result = run(&object, &tuple(0, 0, &[0]), false);
        assert!(
            matches!(&result,Err(EvalError::Reject(e)) if e.code=="E_CERT_OBJECT"),
            "{body}: {result:?}"
        );
    }
    for body in [
        "d = qload r ()\nqunload r () d",
        "qexchm r t t",
        "qstore r t t",
    ] {
        let object = object(body, 1, 1, 1);
        let result = run(&object, &tuple(0, 0, &[0, 0]), false);
        assert!(
            matches!(&result,Err(EvalError::Reject(e)) if e.code=="E_CERT_OBJECT"),
            "{body}: {result:?}"
        );
    }
}

#[test]
fn empty_and_indexed_addresses_and_values_replay_without_truncation() {
    let mut checked = 0;
    for a in 0..2 {
        let address = if a == 0 { "()" } else { "t[0]" };
        for op in ["qstore", "qexchm", "load"] {
            let body = if op == "load" {
                format!(
                    "qpred c\nd = qload r {address}\nqxor d t[1]\nqunload r {address} d\nqunpred c"
                )
            } else {
                format!("qpred c\n{op} r {address} t[1]\nqunpred c")
            };
            let object = object(&body, a, 1, 2);
            for t in 0..4u32 {
                for c in 0..2u32 {
                    for mem in 0..1 << (1 << a) {
                        let cells: Vec<u32> = (0..1 << a).map(|i| (mem >> i) & 1).collect();
                        let before = tuple(t, c, &cells);
                        let mut expected = before.clone();
                        if c != 0 {
                            let index = if a == 0 { 0 } else { (t & 1) as usize };
                            let cell = cells[index];
                            if op == "qstore" {
                                expected.regions[0][index] = ((t >> 1) ^ cell).into();
                            } else if op == "load" {
                                expected.bundles[0] = (t ^ (cell << 1)).into();
                            } else {
                                expected.bundles[0] = (t ^ (((t >> 1) ^ cell) << 1)).into();
                                expected.regions[0][index] = (t >> 1).into();
                            }
                        }
                        let after = run(&object, &before, false).unwrap();
                        assert_eq!(after, expected, "A={a} {op}, t={t}, c={c}, cells={cells:?}");
                        assert_eq!(run(&object, &after, true).unwrap(), before);
                        checked += 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    assert_eq!(checked, 144);
}

#[test]
fn local_regions_exist_at_entry_in_zero_trip_loops_and_are_created_once_per_invocation() {
    for body in [
        "d = qload local ()\nqunload local () d\nqloop 0 {\nqregion local 0 1\n}",
        "qloop 2 {\nqregion local 0 1\nqstore local () t[0]\n}",
        "qif c {\nqregion local 0 1\n} {\n}\nd = qload local ()\nqunload local () d",
    ] {
        let object = object(body, 0, 1, 1);
        for t in 0..2 {
            for c in 0..2 {
                let before = tuple(t, c, &[0]);
                assert_eq!(run(&object, &before, false).unwrap(), before, "{body}");
                assert_eq!(
                    run(&object, &before, true).unwrap(),
                    before,
                    "adjoint {body}"
                );
            }
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn duplicate_local_regions_cannot_erase_dirty_storage_and_overlapping_names_reject() {
    for body in [
        "qregion local 0 1\nqstore local () t\nqregion local 0 1",
        "qregion r 0 1",
        "qregion t 0 1",
        "qregion local 0 0",
    ] {
        let object = object(body, 0, 1, 1);
        let result = run(&object, &tuple(1, 0, &[0]), false);
        assert!(
            matches!(&result,Err(EvalError::Reject(e)) if e.code=="E_CERT_OBJECT"),
            "{body}: {result:?}"
        );
    }
}

#[test]
fn local_images_bind_exact_bytes_and_little_endian_cells_across_adjoint_replay() {
    let mut checked = 0;
    for (a, w, image) in [(0, 8, "a5"), (1, 4, "a5")] {
        let address = if a == 0 { "()" } else { "t[0]" };
        let xor = if a == 0 {
            "qxor d t".to_string()
        } else {
            (0..4)
                .map(|i| format!("cx d[{i}] t[{}]", i + 4))
                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                .join("\n")
        };
        let body=format!("qpred c\nd = qload local {address}\n{xor}\nqunload local {address} d\nqunpred c\nqloop 0 {{\nqregion local {a} {w} @img\n}}");
        let object = object_with_image(&body, 0, 1, 8, Some(image));
        for t in 0..256 {
            for c in 0..2 {
                let before = tuple(t, c, &[0]);
                let mut expected = before.clone();
                if c != 0 {
                    expected.bundles[0] = (t ^ if a == 0 {
                        0xa5
                    } else {
                        if t & 1 == 0 {
                            5 << 4
                        } else {
                            10 << 4
                        }
                    })
                    .into();
                }
                let after = run(&object, &before, false).unwrap();
                assert_eq!(after, expected, "A={a} W={w} t={t} c={c}");
                assert_eq!(run(&object, &after, true).unwrap(), before);
                checked += 1;
            }
        }
    }
    assert_eq!(checked, 1024);
    for image in ["", "00", "000000"] {
        let object = object_with_image("qregion local 1 8 @img", 0, 1, 1, Some(image));
        let result = run(&object, &tuple(0, 0, &[0]), false);
        assert!(
            matches!(&result,Err(EvalError::Reject(e))if e.code=="E_CERT_OBJECT"),
            "{image}: {result:?}"
        );
    }
}
````

````rust
//! ISA-12.1 / ISA-12.2: selected borrow frames remain explicit obligations.
use crate::common;
use bennett_cert_checker::{cert::check_certificate, json::Value};
use common::*;

fn inputs(mut claim: Value) -> bennett_cert_checker::cert::Inputs {
    // K89 witness: clean c, dirty b, identity on b when c=0.
    if claim.get("invocation").is_none() {
        set(
            &mut claim,
            "invocation",
            json(r#"{"args":[],"budget":["0","0","0","0"]}"#),
        );
    }
    standalone(
        "perm_action @a (t:wire mut) () () () ()\nregs {  } bounds {}\n^entry():\nc = qalloc any 1\nb = qborrow any 1\ncx c b\nqreturn b\nqfree c",
        r#"{"a":{"abi":"0.9","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[],"mut":[1],"tier":"q"}}"#,
        "a", vec![claim],
    ).0
}

fn claim() -> Value {
    json(
        r#"{"kind":"exhaustive","expected":"borrow_frame",
    "borrow_frame":{"lifetime":0,"first":"entry:2","last":"entry:2"},
    "domain":{"bundles":[{"name":"t","width":1,"lo":0,"hi":1}],
    "borrowed":[{"name":"b","width":1,"lo":0,"hi":1}],"regions":[],
    "workspace":[{"allocation":"entry:0","offset":0,"width":1,"lo":0,"hi":0}]}}"#,
    )
}

#[test]
fn caq_selected_borrow_frame_products_are_unchecked_until_independently_derived() {
    for union in [false, true] {
        let mut c = claim();
        if union {
            let product = c.get("domain").unwrap().clone();
            let mut domain = json("{}");
            set(&mut domain, "entry_products", Value::Arr(vec![product]));
            set(&mut c, "domain", domain);
        }
        let verdict = check_certificate(&inputs(c));
        assert!(codes(&verdict).is_empty(), "{verdict:?}");
        assert_eq!(verdict.overall, "unchecked", "{verdict:?}");
        let outcome = &verdict.regions[0].claims[0].1;
        assert_eq!(outcome.outcome, "unchecked", "{verdict:?}");
        assert!(outcome
            .unchecked_reason
            .as_deref()
            .unwrap()
            .contains("borrow-frame"));
        assert!(outcome.elements.is_none());
        assert!(outcome.covered_fraction.is_none());
    }
}

#[test]
fn caq_malformed_borrow_frame_bindings_reject_before_unsupported_replay() {
    let base = claim();
    for field in ["lifetime", "first", "last"] {
        let mut c = base.clone();
        let Value::Obj(frame) = c.as_obj().unwrap().get("borrow_frame").unwrap().clone() else {
            panic!()
        };
        let mut frame = frame;
        frame.remove(field);
        set(&mut c, "borrow_frame", Value::Obj(frame));
        let verdict = check_certificate(&inputs(c));
        assert_eq!(verdict.overall, "rejected", "{field}: {verdict:?}");
        assert!(codes(&verdict).contains(&"E_CERT_SCHEMA"), "{verdict:?}");
    }
    let mut c = base;
    set(&mut c, "invocation", json(r#"{"args":[],"budget":[]}"#));
    let verdict = check_certificate(&inputs(c));
    assert_eq!(verdict.overall, "rejected", "{verdict:?}");
    assert!(
        codes(&verdict).contains(&"E_CERT_INVOCATION"),
        "{verdict:?}"
    );
}
````

````rust
//! Certificate schema/binding layer: strict fields, hash bindings, version
//! agreement. Claim replay outcomes are asserted in later test files.

use bennett_cert_checker::cert::{check_certificate, Inputs, Limits};
use bennett_cert_checker::json::{jcs, parse, Value};
use std::path::PathBuf;

#[path = "common/pins.rs"]
mod pins;
fn isa_dir() -> PathBuf {
    pins::isa_spec_dir()
}

struct Fixture {
    cert: Vec<u8>,
    object: String,
    target: Vec<u8>,
    schedule: Vec<u8>,
}

fn controlled() -> Fixture {
    let d = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("tests/fixtures/controlled-action-k87");
    Fixture {
        cert: std::fs::read(d.join("certificate.json")).unwrap(),
        object: std::fs::read_to_string(d.join("controlled.bisa")).unwrap(),
        target: std::fs::read(d.join("target.json")).unwrap(),
        schedule: std::fs::read(d.join("schedule.json")).unwrap(),
    }
}

fn inputs(f: &Fixture) -> Inputs {
    Inputs {
        cert_bytes: f.cert.clone(),
        object_text: f.object.clone(),
        target_bytes: Some(f.target.clone()),
        schedule_bytes: Some(f.schedule.clone()),
        libraries: vec![],
        oracle_bin: None,
        limits: Limits::default(),
    }
}

fn mutate_cert(f: &Fixture, f2: impl FnOnce(&mut Value)) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut v = parse(std::str::from_utf8(&f.cert).unwrap()).unwrap();
    f2(&mut v);
    jcs(&v).unwrap()
}

fn codes(v: &bennett_cert_checker::cert::Verdict) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut out: Vec<String> = v.errors.iter().map(|e| e.code.to_string()).collect();
    for r in &v.regions {
        out.extend(r.errors.iter().map(|e| e.code.to_string()));
        for (_, o) in &r.claims {
            out.extend(o.errors.iter().map(|e| e.code.to_string()));
        }
    }
    out
}

#[test]
fn controlled_certificate_passes_schema_and_bindings() {
    let f = controlled();
    let v = check_certificate(&inputs(&f));
    assert_eq!(
        codes(&v),
        Vec::<String>::new(),
        "verdict: {}",
        String::from_utf8(v.to_json_bytes()).unwrap()
    );
    assert_eq!(
        v.hashes.get("object_hash").map(String::as_str),
        Some("45bbb506541e3a8bb28a18e1bb0aef16ba01ee1e7cac74d5a190deb3ad36ef5a")
    );
    assert_eq!(v.regions.len(), 2);
    let total_claims: usize = v.regions.iter().map(|r| r.claims.len()).sum();
    assert_eq!(total_claims, 3);
}

#[test]
fn verdict_json_is_deterministic() {
    let f = controlled();
    let a = check_certificate(&inputs(&f)).to_json_bytes();
    let b = check_certificate(&inputs(&f)).to_json_bytes();
    assert_eq!(a, b);
    // And re-canonicalising the verdict changes nothing (it is JCS).
    let v = parse(std::str::from_utf8(&a).unwrap()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(jcs(&v).unwrap(), a);
}

#[test]
fn binding_hash_mismatches_reject_with_binding_code() {
    let f = controlled();
    // Flip one hex digit of bindings.object_hash.
    let cert = mutate_cert(&f, |v| {
        let b = v.get("bindings").unwrap().clone();
        let mut m = b.as_obj().unwrap().clone();
        let h = m.get("object_hash").unwrap().as_str().unwrap().to_string();
        let flipped = format!("0{}", &h[1..]);
        let flipped = if flipped == h {
            format!("1{}", &h[1..])
        } else {
            flipped
        };
        m.insert("object_hash".into(), Value::Str(flipped));
        if let Value::Obj(top) = v {
            top.insert("bindings".into(), Value::Obj(m));
        }
    });
    let mut inp = inputs(&f);

    let v = check_certificate(&inp);
    assert_eq!(v.overall, "rejected");
    assert!(
        v.errors
            .iter()
            .any(|e| e.code == "E_CERT_BINDING" && e.path == "bindings.object_hash"),
        "{:?}",
        v.errors
    );
}

#[test]
fn unknown_claim_kind_rejected_per_claim() {
    let f = controlled();
    let cert = mutate_cert(&f, |v| {
        if let Value::Obj(top) = v {
            let mut regions = top.get("regions").unwrap().as_obj().unwrap().clone();
            let key = top
                .get("bindings")
                .unwrap()
                .get("closure_hash")
                .unwrap()
                .as_str()
                .unwrap()
                .to_string();
            let mut region = regions.get(&key).unwrap().as_obj().unwrap().clone();
            let mut claims = region.get("claims").unwrap().as_arr().unwrap().to_vec();
            if let Value::Obj(c0) = &mut claims[0] {
                c0.insert("kind".into(), Value::Str("minimality".into()));
            }
            region.insert("claims".into(), Value::Arr(claims));
            regions.insert(key, Value::Obj(region));
            top.insert("regions".into(), Value::Obj(regions));
        }
    });
    let mut inp = inputs(&f);
    inp.cert_bytes = cert;
    let v = check_certificate(&inp);
    assert_eq!(v.overall, "rejected");
    let root = v
        .regions
        .iter()
        .find(|r| r.name.as_deref() == Some("controlled"))
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(root.claims[0].1.outcome, "reject");
}

            region.insert("frame".into(), frame);

    let v = check_certificate(&inp);
    assert!(
        !codes(&v).iter().any(|c| c == "E_CERT_FRAME"),
        "{:?}",
        codes(&v)
    );
}
````
