````rust
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::process::Command;
fn fixture() -> PathBuf {
    PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("tests/fixtures/controlled-action-k87")
}
fn bin() -> Command {
    Command::new(env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_bennett-check"))
}
#[test]
fn cli_verdict_is_deterministic_and_verifies_the_published_positive() {
    let f = fixture();
    let run = || {
        bin()
            .arg(f.join("certificate.json"))
            .arg("--object")
            .arg(f.join("controlled.bisa"))
            .arg("--target")
            .arg(f.join("target.json"))
            .arg("--schedule")
            .arg(f.join("schedule.json"))
            .output()
            .unwrap()
    };
    let a = run();
    let b = run();
    assert_eq!(a.status.code(), Some(0));
    assert_eq!(a.stdout, b.stdout);
    assert!(a.stderr.is_empty());
    let text = std::str::from_utf8(&a.stdout).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(text.lines().count(), 1);
    let verdict = bennett_cert_checker::json::parse(text).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        verdict.get("overall").and_then(|v| v.as_str()),
        Some("verified")
    );
    assert!(verdict
        .get("unchecked_items")
        .unwrap()
        .as_arr()
        .unwrap()
        .is_empty());
}

struct Scratch(std::path::PathBuf);
impl Scratch {
    fn new() -> Self {
        let root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("checker-cli-{}", std::process::id()));
        std::fs::create_dir(&root).unwrap();
        Self(root)
    }
    fn write(&self, name: &str, bytes: &[u8]) -> std::path::PathBuf {
        let path = self.0.join(name);
        std::fs::write(&path, bytes).unwrap();
        path
    }
}
impl Drop for Scratch {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        std::fs::remove_dir_all(&self.0).expect("remove CLI test inputs");
    }
}

#[test]
fn cli_rejected_io_utf8_and_embedded_errors_have_distinct_exit_contracts() {
    let scratch = Scratch::new();
    let f = fixture();
    let bad_cert = scratch.write("bad.json", b"{}");
    let out = bin()
        .arg(bad_cert)
        .arg("--object")
        .arg(f.join("controlled.bisa"))
        .output()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(out.status.code(), Some(1));
    let v = bennett_cert_checker::json::parse(std::str::from_utf8(&out.stdout).unwrap()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(v.get("overall").unwrap().as_str(), Some("rejected"));
    assert!(out.stderr.is_empty());
    for (path, message) in [
        (scratch.0.join("absent.bisa"), "cannot read"),
        (scratch.write("binary.bisa", &[0xff]), "not UTF-8"),
        (
            scratch.write("no-cert.bisa", b"bennett-object\n"),
            "no certificate section",
        ),
    ] {
        let out = bin().arg("--from-object").arg(path).output().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(out.status.code(), Some(3));
        assert!(out.stdout.is_empty());
        assert!(String::from_utf8(out.stderr).unwrap().contains(message));
    }
}
````

````rust
#![allow(dead_code)]
use bennett_cert_checker::cert::{Inputs, Limits, Verdict};
use bennett_cert_checker::json::{jcs, parse, Value};
use bennett_cert_checker::object::Object;
use std::path::PathBuf;
pub mod pins;

pub fn json(s: &str) -> Value {
    parse(s).unwrap()
}
pub fn set(v: &mut Value, key: &str, x: Value) {
    let Value::Obj(m) = v else {
        panic!("expected object")
    };
    m.insert(key.to_string(), x);
}
pub fn controlled() -> Inputs {
    let d = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("tests/fixtures/controlled-action-k87");
    Inputs {
        cert_bytes: std::fs::read(d.join("certificate.json")).unwrap(),
        object_text: std::fs::read_to_string(d.join("controlled.bisa")).unwrap(),
        target_bytes: Some(std::fs::read(d.join("target.json")).unwrap()),
        schedule_bytes: Some(std::fs::read(d.join("schedule.json")).unwrap()),
        libraries: vec![],
        oracle_bin: None,
        limits: Limits::default(),
    }
}
pub fn codes(v: &Verdict) -> Vec<&str> {
    v.errors
        .iter()
        .chain(v.regions.iter().flat_map(|r| {
            r.errors
                .iter()
                .chain(r.claims.iter().flat_map(|(_, c)| c.errors.iter()))
        }))
        .map(|e| e.code)
        .collect()
}
pub fn encode(v: &Value) -> String {
    String::from_utf8(jcs(v).unwrap()).unwrap()
}
/// Rebind symbol hashes after a source/layout mutation. Certificate/root document
/// bindings, when present, must be rebound separately by the calling test.
pub fn rebind_object_symbols(text: &str) -> String {
    let object = Object::parse(text).unwrap();
    let (prefix, rest) = text.split_once("section symbols\n").unwrap();
    let (symbols, suffix) = rest.split_once("\n\nsection functions\n").unwrap();
    let mut symbols = json(symbols);
    let Value::Obj(fields) = &mut symbols else {
        panic!()
    };
    for entry in fields.values_mut() {
        let name = entry.get("name").unwrap().as_str().unwrap();
        let hash = object.symbol(name).unwrap().interface_hash.clone();
        set(entry, "interface_hash", Value::Str(hash));
    }
    let rebound = format!(
        "{prefix}section symbols\n{}\n\nsection functions\n{suffix}",
        encode(&symbols)
    );
    assert!(Object::parse(&rebound).unwrap().stated_hashes_ok());
    rebound
}

/// Complete independently specified reports for a single zero-error root event.
pub fn single_root_zero_error_reports(inputs: &mut Inputs, resources: Value, gates: Value) {
    let mut cert = json(std::str::from_utf8(&inputs.cert_bytes).unwrap());
    let Value::Obj(top) = &mut cert else { panic!() };
    let Value::Obj(regions) = top.get_mut("regions").unwrap() else {
        panic!()
    };
    assert_eq!(regions.len(), 1);
    let (hash, region) = regions.iter_mut().next().unwrap();
    let hash = hash.clone();
    set(region, "resources", resources);
    set(region, "gates_used", gates);
    set(
        region,
        "error",
        json(r#"{"forward:0":{"local":{"operator_norm":0},"inclusive":{"operator_norm":0}}}"#),
    );
    set(
        &mut cert,
        "composition",
        json(&format!(
            r#"{{"method":"sum_over_multiplicities","epsilon_total":{{"diamond":0}},"multiplicities":{{"{hash}:forward:0":1}}}}"#
        )),
    );
    inputs.cert_bytes = jcs(&cert).unwrap();
}

/// Build a standalone reference certificate for independent test programs.
/// Hashes come from the checker's separately tested §9.2 implementation;
/// expected truth tables in the tests are specified independently.
pub fn standalone(
    functions: &str,
    signatures: &str,
    root: &str,
    claims: Vec<Value>,
) -> (Inputs, String) {
    let signatures = json(signatures);
    let mut symbols = json("{}");
    for (i, (name, sig)) in signatures.as_obj().unwrap().iter().enumerate() {
        let mut entry = json("{}");
        set(&mut entry, "name", Value::Str(name.clone()));
        set(&mut entry, "kind", sig.get("kind").unwrap().clone());
        set(&mut entry, "signature", sig.clone());
        set(&mut entry, "interface_hash", Value::Str("0".repeat(64)));
        set(&mut symbols, &i.to_string(), entry);
    }
    let make_object = |symbols: &Value| {
        format!(
        "bennett-object isa=0.9 object=0.9 launch=0.9 sched=0.9 cert=0.9 coverage=0.9 target=0.9 ptr_width=32\n\nsection symbols\n{}\n\nsection functions\n{}\n", encode(symbols), functions.trim_end())
    };
    let initial = Object::parse(&make_object(&symbols)).unwrap();
    for (i, s) in initial.symbols.iter().enumerate() {
        let Value::Obj(m) = &mut symbols else {
            unreachable!()
        };
        set(
            m.get_mut(&i.to_string()).unwrap(),
            "interface_hash",
            Value::Str(s.interface_hash.clone()),
        );
    }
    let object_text = make_object(&symbols);
    let object = Object::parse(&object_text).unwrap();
    assert!(object.stated_hashes_ok());
    let sym = object.symbol(root).unwrap();
    let h = sym.closure_hash.clone().unwrap();
    let iface = object.interface(root).unwrap();
    let mut region = json(
        r#"{"bounds":[],"claims":[],"cleanup":{},"definedness_assumptions":[],"error":{},"frame":{"ancillae":[],"borrow":[],"history":[],"scratch":[],"slots":[]},"gates_used":{},"resources":{},"verification":{"borrow_frames":[],"channel":[],"fault_rate":{"domain":{"borrowed":[],"bundles":[],"regions":[]},"faults_by_code":{},"layout_dependent_excluded":0,"undefined_excluded":0},"inverse_pairs":[],"oracle":null,"unitary":[]}}"#,
    );
    set(&mut region, "kind", Value::Str(sym.kind.clone()));
    set(&mut region, "signature", sym.signature.clone());
    set(
        &mut region,
        "bounds",
        sym.signature
            .get("bounds")
            .cloned()
            .unwrap_or_else(|| Value::Arr(vec![])),
    );
    let slots = iface
        .bundles
        .iter()
        .map(|b| {
            json(&format!(
                r#"{{"class":"fast","id":"{}:{}","role":"{}","width":{}}}"#,
                b.group,
                b.slot,
                b.group,
                if b.width < (1 << 53) {
                    b.width.to_string()
                } else {
                    format!("\"{}\"", b.width)
                }
            ))
        })
        .collect();
    let mut frame = region.get("frame").unwrap().clone();
    set(&mut frame, "slots", Value::Arr(slots));
    set(&mut region, "frame", frame);
    let claims = claims
        .into_iter()
        .map(|mut c| {
            set(
                &mut c,
                "subject",
                json(&format!(
                    r#"{{"closure_hash":"{h}","inherited_controls":0,"variant":"forward"}}"#
                )),
            );
            c
        })
        .collect();
    set(&mut region, "claims", Value::Arr(claims));
    let mut regions = json("{}");
    set(&mut regions, &h, region);
    let mut cert = json(
        r#"{"bindings":{},"composition":{"epsilon_total":{"diamond":0},"method":"sum_over_multiplicities","multiplicities":{}},"producer":{"materialisation":{"llvm_version":"none","normaliser_version":"1","pipeline":"independent-test"},"name":"checker-tests","version":"1"},"regions":{},"versions":{"cert":"0.9","coverage":"0.9","isa":"0.9","launch":"0.9","object":"0.9","sched":"0.9","target":"0.9"}}"#,
    );
    set(&mut cert, "regions", regions);
    set(
        &mut cert,
        "bindings",
        json(&format!(
            r#"{{"closure_hash":"{h}","interface_hash":"{}","object_hash":"{}","reference_program_hash":"{}"}}"#,
            sym.interface_hash, object.object_hash, sym.interface_hash
        )),
    );
    (
        Inputs {
            cert_bytes: jcs(&cert).unwrap(),
            object_text,
            target_bytes: None,
            schedule_bytes: None,
            libraries: vec![],
            oracle_bin: None,
            limits: Limits::default(),
        },
        h,
    )
}

pub fn bind_schedule(inp: &mut Inputs, mut schedule: Value, target: Value) {
    let object = Object::parse(&inp.object_text).unwrap();
    let mut cert = json(std::str::from_utf8(&inp.cert_bytes).unwrap());
    let root = cert
        .get("bindings")
        .unwrap()
        .get("closure_hash")
        .unwrap()
        .as_str()
        .unwrap();
    let root = object.symbol_by_closure(root).unwrap();
    let th = bennett_cert_checker::sha256_hex(&jcs(&target).unwrap());
    let invocation = cert
        .get("bindings")
        .and_then(|b| b.get("invocation"))
        .cloned()
        .unwrap_or_else(|| json(r#"{"args":[],"budget":["0","0","0","0"]}"#));
    let mut sb = schedule.get("bindings").unwrap().clone();
    set(
        &mut sb,
        "closure_hash",
        Value::Str(root.closure_hash.clone().unwrap()),
    );
    set(&mut sb, "region", Value::Str(root.name.clone()));
    set(&mut sb, "target_hash", Value::Str(th.clone()));
    set(
        &mut sb,
        "params_hash",
        Value::Str(bennett_cert_checker::sha256_hex(
            &jcs(invocation.get("args").unwrap()).unwrap(),
        )),
    );
    set(&mut schedule, "bindings", sb);
    let sh = bennett_cert_checker::sha256_hex(&jcs(&schedule).unwrap());
    let mut bindings = cert.get("bindings").unwrap().clone();
    set(&mut bindings, "target_hash", Value::Str(th));
    set(&mut bindings, "schedule_hash", Value::Str(sh.clone()));
    set(&mut bindings, "invocation", invocation);
    set(&mut cert, "bindings", bindings);
    let Value::Obj(top) = &mut cert else {
        unreachable!()
    };
    let Value::Obj(regions) = top.get_mut("regions").unwrap() else {
        unreachable!()
    };
    for region in regions.values_mut() {
        let Value::Obj(r) = region else {
            unreachable!()
        };
        let Value::Arr(claims) = r.get_mut("claims").unwrap() else {
            unreachable!()
        };
        for c in claims {
            if let Value::Obj(m) = c {
                if let Some(subject) = m.get_mut("subject") {
                    set(subject, "schedule_hash", Value::Str(sh.clone()));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    inp.cert_bytes = jcs(&cert).unwrap();
    inp.target_bytes = Some(jcs(&target).unwrap());
    inp.schedule_bytes = Some(jcs(&schedule).unwrap());
}
````

````rust
//! Resolve published test inputs exclusively through this repository's gate pin.
use std::path::PathBuf;

pub fn isa_spec_dir() -> PathBuf {
    let manifest = include_str!("../../../gate.toml");
    let section = manifest
        .split("[siblings.\"bennett-isa-spec\"]")
        .nth(1)
        .expect("gate.toml must pin bennett-isa-spec");
    let sha = section
        .lines()
        .take_while(|l| !l.starts_with('['))
        .find_map(|l| {
            l.trim()
                .strip_prefix("sha = \"")
                .and_then(|s| s.strip_suffix('"'))
        })
        .expect("ISA gate pin must have a SHA");
    assert_eq!(sha.len(), 40, "ISA gate pin must be a full SHA");
    let path = PathBuf::from(std::env::var_os("BENNETT_ISA_SPEC").unwrap_or_else(|| {
        panic!(
            "BENNETT_ISA_SPEC is required: set it to the detached gate checkout for ISA pin {sha}"
        )
    }));
    let gitfile = std::fs::read_to_string(path.join(".git")).unwrap_or_else(|e| {
        panic!(
            "BENNETT_ISA_SPEC={}: ISA pin {sha}: cannot read .git: {e}",
            path.display()
        )
    });
    let gitdir = gitfile
        .trim()
        .strip_prefix("gitdir: ")
        .expect("BENNETT_ISA_SPEC must identify a detached gate worktree via gitdir");
    let actual = std::fs::read_to_string(path.join(gitdir).join("HEAD")).unwrap_or_else(|e| {
        panic!(
            "BENNETT_ISA_SPEC={}: ISA pin {sha}: cannot read detached HEAD: {e}",
            path.display()
        )
    });
    assert_eq!(
        actual.trim(),
        sha,
        "BENNETT_ISA_SPEC={}: expected detached ISA pin {sha}; actual HEAD {}",
        path.display(),
        actual.trim()
    );
    path
}
````

````rust
use crate::common;
use bennett_cert_checker::{
    cert::{check_certificate, Inputs},
    json::Value,
};
use common::*;

fn table_claim(widths: &[(&str, u32)], rows: Vec<Value>) -> Value {
    let bundles = widths
        .iter()
        .map(|(name, width)| {
            json(&format!(
                r#"{{"name":"{name}","width":{width},"lo":0,"hi":{}}}"#,
                (1u32 << width) - 1
            ))
        })
        .collect();
    let mut domain = json(r#"{"bundles":[],"borrowed":[],"regions":[]}"#);
    set(&mut domain, "bundles", Value::Arr(bundles));
    let mut claim = json(
        r#"{"kind":"exhaustive","label":"proof","invocation":{"args":[],"budget":["0","0","0","0"]},"domain":{},"expected":{"table":[]}}"#,
    );
    set(&mut claim, "domain", domain);
    set(&mut claim, "expected", {
        let mut e = json("{}");
        set(&mut e, "table", Value::Arr(rows));
        e
    });
    claim
}
fn row(before: &[u32], after: &[u32]) -> Value {
    let tuple = |values: &[u32]| {
        let mut t = json(r#"{"bundles":[],"borrowed":[],"regions":[]}"#);
        set(
            &mut t,
            "bundles",
            Value::Arr(values.iter().map(|v| Value::Str(v.to_string())).collect()),
        );
        t
    };
    let mut r = json("{}");
    set(&mut r, "before", tuple(before));
    set(&mut r, "after", tuple(after));
    r
}
fn nested(outer: u32, inner: u32, continuation: bool, wrong: bool) -> Inputs {
    let suffix = if continuation { "\nx t" } else { "" };
    let source=format!("perm_action @a (t:wire mut) (c:wire[{outer}] in, d:wire[{inner}] in) () () ()\nregs {{  }} bounds {{{outer}, {inner}}}\n^entry():\nqloop {outer} while c {{\nqloop {inner} while d {{\nx t\n}}{suffix}\n}}");
    let mut rows = vec![];
    for t in 0..2 {
        for c in 0..1 << outer {
            for d in 0..1 << inner {
                let prefix = |bits: u32, width: u32| {
                    (0..width).take_while(|i| bits & (1 << i) != 0).count() as u32
                };
                let toggle = if wrong {
                    d & 1
                } else {
                    (prefix(c, outer) & 1) * ((prefix(d, inner) & 1) ^ u32::from(continuation))
                };
                rows.push(row(&[t, c, d], &[t ^ toggle, c, d]));
            }
        }
    }
    standalone(&source,&format!(r#"{{"a":{{"abi":"0.9","args":[],"bounds":[{outer},{inner}],"in":[{outer},{inner}],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[],"mut":[1],"tier":"q"}}}}"#),"a",vec![table_claim(&[("t",1),("c",outer),("d",inner)],rows)]).0
}
#[test]
fn nested_while_flags_preserve_disabled_outer_predicates_and_continuations() {
    for (outer, inner) in [(1, 1), (3, 2)] {
        for continuation in [false, true] {
            let verdict = check_certificate(&nested(outer, inner, continuation, false));
            assert!(
                codes(&verdict).is_empty(),
                "{outer}/{inner}, continuation={continuation}: {verdict:?}"
            );
            let claim = &verdict.regions[0].claims[0].1;
            assert_eq!(claim.outcome, "proof", "{verdict:?}");
            assert_eq!(
                claim.elements.as_deref(),
                Some((1u32 << (1 + outer + inner)).to_string().as_str())
            );
        }
    }
}
#[test]
fn nested_while_cannot_certify_the_reviewed_wrong_inner_only_relation() {
    let verdict = check_certificate(&nested(1, 1, false, true));
    assert!(codes(&verdict).contains(&"E_CERT_REPLAY"), "{verdict:?}");
    assert_eq!(verdict.regions[0].claims[0].1.outcome, "reject");
}

#[test]
fn qif_executes_both_arms_unconditional_lifetimes_and_predicates_only_gates() {
    for (body, mode) in [
        ("qif c {\nd = qalloc any 1\n} {\nqfree d\n}", 0),
        ("qif c {\nd = qalloc any 1\nx t\n} {\nqfree d\n}", 1),
        (
            "qpred e\nqif c {\nd = qalloc any 1\nx t\n} {\nx t\nqfree d\n}\nqunpred e",
            2,
        ),
    ] {
        let mut rows = vec![];
        for t in 0..2 {
            for c in 0..2 {
                for e in 0..2 {
                    let toggle = match mode {
                        0 => 0,
                        1 => c,
                        _ => e,
                    };
                    rows.push(row(&[t, c, e], &[t ^ toggle, c, e]));
                }
            }
        }
        let source =
            format!("action @a (t:wire mut) (c:wire in, e:wire in) () () ()\n^entry():\n{body}");
        let (inputs, _) = standalone(
            &source,
            r#"{"a":{"abi":"0.9","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[1,1],"kind":"action","mem":[],"mut":[1],"tier":"q"}}"#,
            "a",
            vec![table_claim(&[("t", 1), ("c", 1), ("e", 1)], rows)],
        );
        let verdict = check_certificate(&inputs);
        assert!(codes(&verdict).is_empty(), "mode={mode}: {verdict:?}");
        assert_eq!(
            verdict.regions[0].claims[0].1.outcome, "proof",
            "{verdict:?}"
        );
    }
}

fn sampled_identity(rows: Vec<Value>) -> Inputs {
    let mut claim = table_claim(&[("t", 1)], rows);
    set(&mut claim, "kind", Value::Str("sampled".into()));
    set(&mut claim, "label", Value::Str("evidence".into()));
    set(
        &mut claim,
        "sampler",
        json(r#"{"algorithm":"xoshiro256**","seed":["1","0","0","0"],"count":1}"#),
    );
    standalone("perm_action @a (t:wire mut) () () () ()\n^entry():",
        r#"{"a":{"abi":"0.9","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[],"mut":[1],"tier":"q"}}"#,"a",vec![claim]).0
}
#[test]
fn sampled_tables_cover_the_declared_domain_while_execution_covers_only_draws() {
    let mut inputs = sampled_identity(vec![row(&[0], &[0]), row(&[1], &[1])]);
    inputs.limits.max_elements = 1; // Bounds draws, not declared-table completeness.
    let verdict = check_certificate(&inputs);
    assert!(codes(&verdict).is_empty(), "{verdict:?}");
    let claim = &verdict.regions[0].claims[0].1;
    assert_eq!(claim.outcome, "evidence", "{verdict:?}");
    assert_eq!(claim.draws.as_deref(), Some("1"));
    assert_eq!(claim.distinct.as_deref(), Some("1"));
    assert_eq!(claim.covered_fraction.as_deref(), Some("1/2"));
    // A legal but false output at the undrawn point is not checked by this
    // sample; the verdict must continue to describe only the one drawn point.
    let verdict = check_certificate(&sampled_identity(vec![row(&[0], &[0]), row(&[1], &[0])]));
    assert!(codes(&verdict).is_empty(), "{verdict:?}");
    assert_eq!(verdict.regions[0].claims[0].1.outcome, "evidence");
}
#[test]
fn sampled_tables_reject_missing_duplicate_reordered_and_malformed_undrawn_rows() {
    for rows in [
        vec![row(&[0], &[0])],
        vec![row(&[0], &[0]), row(&[0], &[0])],
        vec![row(&[1], &[1]), row(&[0], &[0])],
        vec![row(&[0], &[0]), row(&[1], &[2])],
    ] {
        let verdict = check_certificate(&sampled_identity(rows));
        assert!(codes(&verdict).contains(&"E_CERT_TABLE"), "{verdict:?}");
    }
}

#[test]
fn every_sampler_field_and_seed_position_rejects_bad_types_and_removals() {
    let base = sampled_identity(vec![row(&[0], &[0]), row(&[1], &[1])]);
    let mut rejected = 0;
    for remove in [false, true] {
        for field in 0..8 {
            let mut cert = json(std::str::from_utf8(&base.cert_bytes).unwrap());
            let Value::Obj(top) = &mut cert else { panic!() };
            let Value::Obj(regions) = top.get_mut("regions").unwrap() else {
                panic!()
            };
            let Value::Obj(record) = regions.values_mut().next().unwrap() else {
                panic!()
            };
            let Value::Arr(claims) = record.get_mut("claims").unwrap() else {
                panic!()
            };
            let Value::Obj(claim) = &mut claims[0] else {
                panic!()
            };
            if field == 0 {
                if remove {
                    claim.remove("sampler");
                } else {
                    claim.insert("sampler".into(), Value::Null);
                }
            } else {
                let Value::Obj(sampler) = claim.get_mut("sampler").unwrap() else {
                    panic!()
                };
                if field <= 3 {
                    let key = ["algorithm", "seed", "count"][field - 1];
                    if remove {
                        sampler.remove(key);
                    } else {
                        sampler.insert(key.into(), Value::Null);
                    }
                } else {
                    let Value::Arr(seed) = sampler.get_mut("seed").unwrap() else {
                        panic!()
                    };
                    if remove {
                        seed.remove(field - 4);
                    } else {
                        seed[field - 4] = Value::Null;
                    }
                }
            }
            let mut inputs = base.clone();
            inputs.cert_bytes = bennett_cert_checker::json::jcs(&cert).unwrap();
            let verdict = check_certificate(&inputs);
            let code = if remove && field == 0 {
                "E_CERT_SCHEMA"
            } else {
                "E_CERT_SAMPLER"
            };
            assert!(
                codes(&verdict).contains(&code),
                "remove={remove}, field={field}: {verdict:?}"
            );
            rejected += 1;
        }
    }
    assert_eq!(rejected, 16);
}

#[test]
fn while_selectors_cannot_be_modified_even_if_the_claim_matches_a_noninjective_map() {
    for (body, kind) in [
        ("x c", 0),
        ("swap c t", 1),
        ("qxor t c", 2),
        ("action_call @flip (c) () () ()", 0),
    ] {
        let mut source=format!("perm_action @a (t:wire mut, c:wire mut) () () () ()\nregs {{  }} bounds {{1}}\n^entry():\nqloop 1 while c {{\n{body}\n}}");
        let mut signatures = json(
            r#"{"a":{"abi":"0.9","args":[],"bounds":[1],"in":[],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[],"mut":[1,1],"tier":"q"}}"#,
        );
        if body.starts_with("action_call") {
            source.push_str("\nperm_action @flip (x:wire mut) () () () ()\n^entry():\nx x");
            set(
                &mut signatures,
                "flip",
                json(
                    r#"{"abi":"0.9","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[],"mut":[1],"tier":"q"}"#,
                ),
            );
        }
        let mut rows = vec![];
        for t in 0..2 {
            for c in 0..2 {
                let after = match kind {
                    0 => vec![t, 0],
                    1 => vec![t | c, t & c],
                    _ => vec![t, c & (1 - t)],
                };
                rows.push(row(&[t, c], &after));
            }
        }
        let (inputs, _) = standalone(
            &source,
            &encode(&signatures),
            "a",
            vec![table_claim(&[("t", 1), ("c", 1)], rows)],
        );
        let verdict = check_certificate(&inputs);
        assert!(
            codes(&verdict).contains(&"E_CERT_OBJECT"),
            "{body}: {verdict:?}"
        );
    }
}

#[test]
fn selector_guard_follows_callee_reads_without_treating_a_mutable_formal_as_a_write() {
    for indexed in [false, true] {
        for read_only_gate in [false, true] {
            let gate = if read_only_gate { "\ncx c t" } else { "" };
            let width = if indexed { 2 } else { 1 };
            let actual = if indexed { "t[0], c[0]" } else { "t, c" };
            let source=format!("perm_action @a (t:wire[{width}] mut, c:wire mut) () () () ()\nregs {{  }} bounds {{1}}\n^entry():\nqloop 1 while c {{\naction_call @reader ({actual}) () () ()\n}}\nx c\nperm_action @reader (t:wire mut, c:wire mut) () () () ()\n^entry():{gate}");
            let mut rows = vec![];
            for t in 0..1 << width {
                for c in 0..2 {
                    rows.push(row(
                        &[t, c],
                        &[t ^ if read_only_gate { c } else { 0 }, c ^ 1],
                    ));
                }
            }
            let signatures = format!(
                r#"{{"a":{{"abi":"0.9","args":[],"bounds":[1],"in":[],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[],"mut":[{width},1],"tier":"q"}},"reader":{{"abi":"0.9","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[],"mut":[1,1],"tier":"q"}}}}"#
            );
            let (inputs, _) = standalone(
                &source,
                &signatures,
                "a",
                vec![table_claim(&[("t", width), ("c", 1)], rows)],
            );
            let verdict = check_certificate(&inputs);
            assert!(codes(&verdict).is_empty(), "{verdict:?}");
            assert_eq!(verdict.regions[0].claims[0].1.outcome, "proof");
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn action_memory_actuals_preserve_origins_and_require_exact_shapes_and_disjointness() {
    use bennett_cert_checker::{
        domain::Tuple,
        eval::{eval_action_tuple, EvalError},
        object::Object,
    };
    for (a, w, duplicate) in [(0, 1, false), (1, 1, false), (0, 2, false), (0, 1, true)] {
        let actual = if duplicate { "r, r" } else { "r" };
        let formal = if duplicate {
            format!("p:region[{a},{w}] mut, q:region[{a},{w}] mut")
        } else {
            format!("p:region[{a},{w}] mut")
        };
        let source=format!("perm_action @a (t:wire mut) () (r:region[0,1] mut) () ()\n^entry():\naction_call @reader (t) () ({actual}) ()\nperm_action @reader (t:wire mut) () ({formal}) () ()\n^entry():");
        let mem = json(&format!(r#"{{"A":{a},"W":{w},"role":"mut"}}"#));
        let mut reader = json(
            r#"{"abi":"0.9","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[],"mut":[1],"tier":"q"}"#,
        );
        set(
            &mut reader,
            "mem",
            Value::Arr(vec![mem; if duplicate { 2 } else { 1 }]),
        );
        let mut signatures = json(
            r#"{"a":{"abi":"0.9","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[{"A":0,"W":1,"role":"mut"}],"mut":[1],"tier":"q"}}"#,
        );
        set(&mut signatures, "reader", reader);
        let (inputs, _) = standalone(&source, &encode(&signatures), "a", vec![]);
        let text=rebind_object_symbols(&format!("{}\nsection layout\n{{\"A_tab\":0,\"H\":4,\"S_cells\":0,\"globals\":{{}},\"heap_base\":1,\"heap_limit_max\":0,\"interface_regions\":{{}},\"null_size\":1,\"ptr_width\":32}}\n",inputs.object_text));
        let object = Object::parse(&text).unwrap();
        let symbol = object.symbol("a").unwrap();
        let iface = object.interface("a").unwrap();
        for t in 0..2u32 {
            for cell in 0..2u32 {
                let before = Tuple {
                    bundles: vec![t.into()],
                    borrowed: vec![],
                    regions: vec![vec![cell.into()]],
                    args: vec![],
                };
                let result = eval_action_tuple(&object, symbol, &iface, &before, &[], 0, false, 0);
                if (a, w, duplicate) == (0, 1, false) {
                    assert_eq!(result.unwrap(), before);
                } else {
                    assert!(matches!(result,Err(EvalError::Reject(e))if e.code=="E_CERT_OBJECT"));
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn qif_lifetime_adjoints_reverse_the_complete_expansion_and_all_blocks() {
    for case in 0..3 {
        let body=match case {
            0=>"^entry():\nqif c {\nd = qalloc any 1\n} {\nqfree d\n}",
            1=>"^entry():\nqif c {\nd = qalloc any 1\nx t\n} {\nqfree d\n}",
            _=>"^entry():\nd = qalloc any 2\ncx t u\n^middle():\nqif c {\nx t\n} {\n}\n^done():\nqfree d",
        };
        let params = if case == 2 {
            "t:wire mut, u:wire mut"
        } else {
            "t:wire mut"
        };
        let actual = if case == 2 { "t, u" } else { "t" };
        let mut source=format!("perm_action @inverse ({params}) (c:wire in) () () ()\n^entry():\nadj action_call @a ({actual}) (c) () ()\nperm_action @a ({params}) (c:wire in) () () ()\n{body}");
        source.push('\n');
        let widths = if case == 2 { "[1,1]" } else { "[1]" };
        let signature = format!(
            r#"{{"abi":"0.9","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[1],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[],"mut":{widths},"tier":"q"}}"#
        );
        let signatures = format!(r#"{{"a":{signature},"inverse":{signature}}}"#);
        let mut rows = vec![];
        for t in 0..2 {
            for u in 0..if case == 2 { 2 } else { 1 } {
                for c in 0..2 {
                    if case == 2 {
                        rows.push(row(&[t, u, c], &[t ^ c, u ^ t ^ c, c]));
                    } else {
                        rows.push(row(&[t, c], &[t ^ if case == 1 { c } else { 0 }, c]));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        let fields = if case == 2 {
            vec![("t", 1), ("u", 1), ("c", 1)]
        } else {
            vec![("t", 1), ("c", 1)]
        };
        let (inputs, _) = standalone(
            &source,
            &signatures,
            "inverse",
            vec![table_claim(&fields, rows)],
        );
        let verdict = check_certificate(&inputs);
        assert!(codes(&verdict).is_empty(), "{verdict:?}");
        assert_eq!(
            verdict.regions[0].claims[0].1.outcome, "proof",
            "case={case}: {verdict:?}"
        );
    }
}

fn indexed_bulk_gates_preserve_other_bits_and_allow_read_only_predicate_sources() {

                (0..2).map(move |c| {

                        match op {
                            "qxor t[0] t[1]" => t ^ ((t & 1) << 1),
                            "qexch t[0] t[1]" => ((t & 1) << 1) | ((t >> 1) & 1),

        let (inputs, _) = standalone(

        );
    }
}

#[test]
fn malformed_predicate_scopes_and_dangling_control_prefixes_cannot_prove_tables() {
    for (body, conditional) in [
        ("qpred c\nx t", true),
        ("qunpred c", false),
        ("qpred c\nqunpred t", false),
        ("qpred c\nqunpred c ignored", false),
        ("ctl c", false),
        ("qloop 1 while c {\nqpred c\n}", false),
    ] {
        let source = format!("perm_action @a (t:wire mut) (c:wire in) () () ()\n^entry():\n{body}");
        let rows = (0..2)
            .flat_map(|t| {
                (0..2).map(move |c| row(&[t, c], &[t ^ if conditional { c } else { 0 }, c]))
            })
            .collect();
        let (mut inputs, _) = standalone(
            &source.replace("\nctl c", "\nx t"),
            r#"{"a":{"abi":"0.9","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[1],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[],"mut":[1],"tier":"q"}}"#,
            "a",
            vec![table_claim(&[("t", 1), ("c", 1)], rows)],
        );
        if body == "ctl c" {
            inputs.object_text = inputs.object_text.replace("\nx t", "\nctl c");
        }
        let verdict = check_certificate(&inputs);
        assert!(
            codes(&verdict).contains(&"E_CERT_OBJECT"),
            "{body}: {verdict:?}"
        );
    }
}
#[test]
fn repeated_predicate_pushes_can_balance_across_counted_loops_and_blocks() {
    let source="perm_action @a (t:wire mut) (c:wire in) () () ()\nregs {  } bounds {2, 2}\n^entry():\nqloop 2 {\nqpred c\n}\n^middle():\nx t\nqloop 2 {\nqunpred c\n}";
    let rows = (0..2)
        .flat_map(|t| (0..2).map(move |c| row(&[t, c], &[t ^ c, c])))
        .collect();
    let (inputs, _) = standalone(
        source,
        r#"{"a":{"abi":"0.9","args":[],"bounds":[2,2],"in":[1],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[],"mut":[1],"tier":"q"}}"#,
        "a",
        vec![table_claim(&[("t", 1), ("c", 1)], rows)],
    );
    let verdict = check_certificate(&inputs);
    assert!(codes(&verdict).is_empty(), "{verdict:?}");
    assert_eq!(
        verdict.regions[0].claims[0].1.outcome, "proof",
        "{verdict:?}"
    );
}

#[test]
fn qif_selector_writes_cannot_escape_through_balanced_explicit_pops_or_callees() {
    let mut checked = 0;
    for operation in ["x t[0]", "action_call @flip (t[0]) () () ()"] {
        for adjoint in [false, true] {
            for selector in ["t[0]", "t[-0]"] {
                let mut source=format!("perm_action @a (t:wire[2] mut) () () () ()\n^entry():\nqif {selector} {{\nqunpred {selector}\n{operation}\nqpred {selector}\n}} {{\n}}\nperm_action @flip (v:wire mut) () () () ()\n^entry():\nx v");
                let mut sig = json(
                    r#"{"a":{"abi":"0.9","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[],"mut":[2],"tier":"q"},"flip":{"abi":"0.9","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[],"mut":[1],"tier":"q"}}"#,
                );
                let root = if adjoint {
                    source.push_str("\nperm_action @inverse (t:wire[2] mut) () () () ()\n^entry():\nadj action_call @a (t) () () ()");
                    let signature = sig.get("a").unwrap().clone();
                    set(&mut sig, "inverse", signature);
                    "inverse"
                } else {
                    "a"
                };
                let rows = (0..4).map(|t| row(&[t], &[t ^ 1])).collect();
                let (mut inputs, _) = standalone(
                    &source.replace("[-0]", "[0]"),
                    &encode(&sig),
                    root,
                    vec![table_claim(&[("t", 2)], rows)],
                );
                if selector == "t[-0]" {
                    inputs.object_text = inputs.object_text.replace("t[0]", "t[-0]");
                }
                let verdict = check_certificate(&inputs);
                assert!(
                    codes(&verdict).contains(&"E_CERT_OBJECT"),
                    "{operation} adjoint={adjoint} selector={selector}: {verdict:?}"
                );
                checked += 1;
            }
        }
    }
    assert_eq!(checked, 8);
}
#[test]
fn indexed_qif_guards_preserve_unrelated_bits_and_forward_the_precise_callee_bit() {
    let mut checked = 0;
    for call in [false, true] {
        for adjoint in [false, true] {
            for selector in ["t[0]", "t[-0]"] {
                let body = if call {
                    format!("qunpred {selector}\naction_call @other (t) () () ()\nqpred {selector}")
                } else {
                    "x t[1]".into()
                };
                let mut source=format!("perm_action @a (t:wire[2] mut) () () () ()\n^entry():\nqif {selector} {{\n{body}\n}} {{\n}}\nperm_action @other (v:wire[2] mut) () () () ()\n^entry():\nx v[1]");
                let mut sig = json(
                    r#"{"a":{"abi":"0.9","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[],"mut":[2],"tier":"q"},"other":{"abi":"0.9","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[],"mut":[2],"tier":"q"}}"#,
                );
                let root = if adjoint {
                    source.push_str("\nperm_action @inverse (t:wire[2] mut) () () () ()\n^entry():\nadj action_call @a (t) () () ()");
                    let signature = sig.get("a").unwrap().clone();
                    set(&mut sig, "inverse", signature);
                    "inverse"
                } else {
                    "a"
                };
                let rows = (0..4)
                    .map(|t| row(&[t], &[t ^ if call { 2 } else { (t & 1) << 1 }]))
                    .collect();
                let (mut inputs, _) = standalone(
                    &source.replace("[-0]", "[0]"),
                    &encode(&sig),
                    root,
                    vec![table_claim(&[("t", 2)], rows)],
                );
                if selector == "t[-0]" {
                    inputs.object_text = inputs.object_text.replace("t[0]", "t[-0]");
                }
                let verdict = check_certificate(&inputs);
                if selector == "t[-0]" {
                    assert!(codes(&verdict).contains(&"E_CERT_OBJECT"), "{verdict:?}");
                    assert!(
                        verdict.errors.iter().any(|e| e.section == "§16.1"),
                        "{verdict:?}"
                    );
                    checked += 1;
                    continue;
                }
                assert!(
                    codes(&verdict).is_empty(),
                    "call={call} adjoint={adjoint} selector={selector}: {verdict:?}"
                );
                assert_eq!(
                    verdict.regions[0].claims[0].1.outcome, "proof",
                    "{verdict:?}"
                );
                checked += 1;
            }
        }
    }
    assert_eq!(checked, 8);
}
````

````rust
//! Slice-1 witness tests: SHA-256, JSON/JCS (RFC 8785), exact rationals,
//! pinned by ISA 0.9 spec values (sections 8.3, 9.4, 11.1, 12.3).

use bennett_cert_checker::json::{jcs, parse, Value};
use bennett_cert_checker::rat::{parse_decimal, upward_decimal_34, Rat};
use bennett_cert_checker::sha256_hex;
use num_traits::Zero;
use std::path::PathBuf;

#[path = "common/pins.rs"]
mod pins;
fn isa_spec_dir() -> PathBuf {
    pins::isa_spec_dir()
}

#[test]
fn sha256_standard_vectors() {
    assert_eq!(
        sha256_hex(b""),
        "e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        sha256_hex(b"abc"),
        "ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        sha256_hex(b"abcdbcdecdefdefgefghfghighijhijkijkljklmklmnlmnomnopnopq"),
        "248d6a61d20638b8e5c026930c3e6039a33ce45964ff2167f6ecedd419db06c1"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        sha256_hex(b"[]"),
        "4f53cda18c2baa0c0354bb5f9a3ecbe5ed12ab4d8e11ba873c2f11161202b945"
    );
}

#[test]
fn jcs_number_rendering() {
    let cases = [
        ("0", "0"),
        ("-0", "0"),
        ("1", "1"),
        ("-1", "-1"),
        ("1.5", "1.5"),
        ("0.1", "0.1"),
        ("1e21", "1e+21"),
        ("1E21", "1e+21"),
        ("1e20", "100000000000000000000"),
        ("0.000001", "0.000001"),
        ("1e-7", "1e-7"),
        ("333333333.33333329", "333333333.3333333"),
        ("1.0", "1"),
        ("123456789012345680000", "123456789012345680000"),
    ];
    for (input, expect) in cases {
        let v = parse(input).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("parse {input}: {e}"));
        assert_eq!(jcs(&v).unwrap(), expect.as_bytes(), "input {input}");
    }
}

#[test]
fn jcs_object_key_order_and_escapes() {
    let v = parse(r#"{"b":1,"a":"x\"y\n","aa":[true,null]}"#).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        jcs(&v).unwrap(),
        br#"{"a":"x\"y\n","aa":[true,null],"b":1}"#
    );
    // duplicate keys are ill-formed input, never canonicalisable silently
    assert!(parse(r#"{"a":1,"a":2}"#).is_err());
    // trailing garbage rejected
    assert!(parse("{} x").is_err());
    assert!(parse("").is_err());
}

#[test]
fn claim_binding_params_hash_witness() {
    // ISA 0.9 section 12.3 CLAIM-BINDING witness.
    let args = parse(r#"["18446744073709551617","0x8000000000000000",["2","0","0","0"]]"#).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        sha256_hex(&jcs(&args).unwrap()),
        "9f628a694fa7259bf899bfb677aabce1c084e268a738a40f7f643eb6d8c9c093"
    );
    // +0 vs -0 f64 differ; token id never appears (tuple only).
    let args2 =
        parse(r#"["18446744073709551617","0x0000000000000000",["2","0","0","0"]]"#).unwrap();
    assert_ne!(
        sha256_hex(&jcs(&args2).unwrap()),
        sha256_hex(&jcs(&args).unwrap())
    );
}

#[test]
fn topology_and_frame_witness_hashes() {
    // Canonical bytes as printed in ISA 0.9 sections 8.3 and 9.4 (code fence content, no LF).
    let topo = parse(r#"{"capabilities":{"classical_step_time":1,"max_parallel":"unbounded","max_predicate_depth":"unbounded","mbu":false,"measurement":{"feedforward_latency":0,"mid_circuit":false}},"classes":{"fast":{"capacity":4,"dirty_rate":1,"qubit_second":1}},"gates":[{"classes":["fast"],"controls":{"max":1,"min":1},"cost":{"time":1},"epsilon":0,"op":"cx"}],"imports":{},"objective":{"weighted":{"time":1}},"ptr_widths_supported":[32],"qram":null,"resources":{"peak_qubits":{"kind":"peak","unit":"qubit"},"qubit_second":{"kind":"occupancy","unit":"qubit_second"},"time":{"kind":"time","unit":"second"}},"schemes":[],"tables":{},"topology":{"edges":[[0,1],[0,2],[1,3],[2,3]],"vertices":[{"class":"fast"},{"class":"fast"},{"class":"fast"},{"class":"fast"}]}}"#).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        sha256_hex(&jcs(&topo).unwrap()),
        "960cee71e88da141cc6c2b13cab3f28fce1d50c006e67446aadb592e2bfd0882"
    );
    let frame = parse(r#"{"ancillae":[{"class":"fast","id":"a","scheme":"controlled-x","state":"clean","width":{"var":"c"}}],"borrow":[{"class":"fast","id":"b","width":1}],"history":[{"class":"fast","id":"h","width":3}],"live_ranges":[{"end":2,"frame":"s","start":0},{"end":4,"frame":"s","start":2}],"scratch":[{"class":"fast","id":"s","state":"clean","width":{"args":[2,{"var":"c"}],"op":"+"}}],"slots":[{"class":"fast","id":"mut:0","role":"mut","width":2},{"class":"fast","id":"in:0","role":"in","width":1}]}"#).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        sha256_hex(&jcs(&frame).unwrap()),
        "f314eeef24a5a65a9c72f91e062aa3c83556358eaca166e689571700a72083ff"
    );
}

#[test]
fn controlled_fixture_documents_are_jcs_and_hash_linked() {
    let dir = isa_spec_dir().join("conformance/fixtures/controlled-action-09");
    let cert_b = std::fs::read(dir.join("certificate.json")).expect("controlled fixture present");
    let sched_b = std::fs::read(dir.join("schedule.json")).unwrap();
    let tgt_b = std::fs::read(dir.join("target.json")).unwrap();
    for (name, b) in [
        ("certificate", &cert_b),
        ("schedule", &sched_b),
        ("target", &tgt_b),
    ] {
        let v = parse(std::str::from_utf8(b).unwrap()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(&jcs(&v).unwrap(), b, "{name} must already be JCS bytes");
    }
    let cert = parse(std::str::from_utf8(&cert_b).unwrap()).unwrap();
    let bindings = cert.get("bindings").unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        bindings.get("schedule_hash").unwrap().as_str().unwrap(),
        sha256_hex(&sched_b)
    );
    assert_eq!(
        bindings.get("target_hash").unwrap().as_str().unwrap(),
        sha256_hex(&tgt_b)
    );
}

#[test]
fn ref_library_envelope_hash() {
    // ISA 0.9 section 11.1: SHA-256 of the four-line envelope.
    let lib =
        std::fs::read(isa_spec_dir().join("spec/ref-0.9.json")).expect("ref-0.9.json present");
    let mut env = b"isa=0.9\nexpansion=ref\nversion=0.9\n".to_vec();
    env.extend_from_slice(&lib);
    env.push(b'\n');
    assert_eq!(
        sha256_hex(&env),
        "5de4e4995350313e50217880ba1b95de39cd043283b726337d4894efb005d197"
    );
}

#[test]
fn decimal_rationals_exact() {
    assert_eq!(parse_decimal("0").unwrap(), Rat::zero());
    assert_eq!(
        parse_decimal("0.1").unwrap() * parse_decimal("3").unwrap(),
        parse_decimal("0.3").unwrap()
    );
    assert!(
        parse_decimal("1/3").is_err(),
        "fractions are not decimal text"
    );
    assert!(parse_decimal("01").is_err(), "non-canonical leading zero");
    assert!(parse_decimal("").is_err());
    // numbers equal regardless of spelling (ISA section 11: 0 = \"0.0\" = \"0.000\")
    assert_eq!(parse_decimal("0.000").unwrap(), Rat::zero());
}

#[test]
fn upward_decimal_34_witness() {
    // ISA 0.9 section 10.1 decimal_checks.
    let cases = [
        ("0", "1", "0"),
        ("2", "1", "2"),
        ("1", "8", "0.125"),
        ("1", "3", "0.3333333333333333333333333333333334"),
        ("2", "3", "0.6666666666666666666666666666666667"),
        ("1", "30", "0.03333333333333333333333333333333334"),
        ("10", "3", "3.333333333333333333333333333333334"),
    ];
    for (n, d, expect) in cases {
        let q = Rat::new(n.parse().unwrap(), d.parse().unwrap());
        assert_eq!(upward_decimal_34(&q).unwrap(), expect, "{n}/{d}");
    }
}

#[test]
fn value_number_lexeme_preserved() {
    let v = parse("18446744073709551617").unwrap();
    match v {
        Value::Num(lex) => assert_eq!(lex, "18446744073709551617"),
        other => panic!("expected number, got {other:?}"),
    }
}
````

````rust
use crate::common;
use bennett_cert_checker::cert::check_certificate;
use bennett_cert_checker::json::{jcs, Value};
use bennett_cert_checker::rat::parse_decimal;
use common::*;
#[test]
fn decimal_scale_never_wraps_at_u32_boundaries() {
    for text in [
        "1e4294967296",
        "1e-4294967296",
        "1e-9223372036854775808",
        "1e999999999999999999999999999999999999",
    ] {
        assert!(
            parse_decimal(text).is_err(),
            "scale silently truncated for {text}"
        );
    }
    assert_eq!(
        parse_decimal("0e99999999999999999999999999999").unwrap(),
        parse_decimal("0").unwrap()
    );
    for malformed in [
        "1e",
        "1e+",
        "1e--99999999999999999999",
        "01e99999999",
        ".1e99999999",
    ] {
        assert!(
            !parse_decimal(malformed).unwrap_err().contains("host limit"),
            "{malformed}"
        );
    }
}
#[test]
fn excessive_report_decimals_are_unchecked_host_limits() {
    for subject in ["certificate", "target", "schedule"] {
        let mut inp = controlled();
        match subject {
            "certificate" => {
                let mut cert = json(std::str::from_utf8(&inp.cert_bytes).unwrap());
                let Value::Obj(top) = &mut cert else {
                    unreachable!()
                };
                let Value::Obj(regions) = top.get_mut("regions").unwrap() else {
                    unreachable!()
                };
                let Value::Obj(region) = regions.values_mut().next().unwrap() else {
                    unreachable!()
                };
                set(
                    region.get_mut("resources").unwrap(),
                    "time",
                    Value::Str(format!("1{}", "0".repeat(100_001))),
                );
                inp.cert_bytes = jcs(&cert).unwrap();
            }
            other => {
                let mut target =
                    json(std::str::from_utf8(inp.target_bytes.as_ref().unwrap()).unwrap());
                let mut schedule =
                    json(std::str::from_utf8(inp.schedule_bytes.as_ref().unwrap()).unwrap());
                if other == "target" {
                    let Value::Obj(top) = &mut target else {
                        unreachable!()
                    };
                    let Value::Arr(gates) = top.get_mut("gates").unwrap() else {
                        unreachable!()
                    };
                    let Value::Obj(gate) = &mut gates[0] else {
                        unreachable!()
                    };
                    set(
                        gate.get_mut("cost").unwrap(),
                        "time",
                        Value::Str("1e-4294967296".into()),
                    );
                } else {
                    let Value::Obj(top) = &mut schedule else {
                        unreachable!()
                    };
                    set(
                        top.get_mut("bindings").unwrap(),
                        "epsilon",
                        Value::Str("1e-4294967296".into()),
                    );
                }
                bind_schedule(&mut inp, schedule, target);
            }
        }
        let v = check_certificate(&inp);
        assert_eq!(v.overall, "unchecked", "{subject}: {v:?}");
        assert!(codes(&v).is_empty(), "{v:?}");
        assert!(
            v.unchecked_items
                .iter()
                .any(|s| s.contains("host limit") && s.contains(subject)),
            "{v:?}"
        );
    }
}
````

````rust
//! Section 12.2 domain resolution/coverage and section 12.1 sampling,
//! pinned by the COMPONENT-COVERAGE and CLAIM-REPLAY witnesses.

use bennett_cert_checker::domain::{resolve_domain, ResolveError};
use bennett_cert_checker::json::parse;
use bennett_cert_checker::object::Object;
use bennett_cert_checker::sampler::{draw_elements, Sampler};

#[path = "common/pins.rs"]
mod pins;

fn t3() -> Object {
    let text = std::fs::read_to_string(
        pins::isa_spec_dir().join("conformance/cases/objects/t3_domains.bisa"),
    )
    .unwrap();
    Object::parse(&text).unwrap()
}

#[test]
fn component_coverage_witness_arithmetic() {
    // ISA 0.9 COMPONENT-COVERAGE witness against borrow_tuple
    // (mut t,u width 1; the witness action borrows one bit; here the
    // borrowed entry is positional and can never cover mut t).
    let o = t3();
    // borrow_tuple has no qborrow; use oracle_tuple-style direct interface
    // arithmetic on borrow_tuple bundles only for the bundle half:
    let iface = o.interface("borrow_tuple").unwrap();
    let domain =
        parse(r#"{"bundles":[{"name":"u","width":1,"lo":0,"hi":1}],"borrowed":[],"regions":[]}"#)
            .unwrap();
    // borrow_tuple bundles are named t,b (mut) and x (in) in this object;
    // "u" is unknown here and must reject — resolution is by header name.
    match resolve_domain(&domain, &iface, 0) {
        Err(ResolveError::Reject(e)) => assert!(e.message.contains("u"), "{e:?}"),
        other => panic!("expected reject, got {other:?}"),
    }
}

#[test]
fn omitted_component_is_zero_slice_not_full_range() {
    let o = t3();
    let iface = o.interface("borrow_tuple").unwrap();
    // mut t,b and in x: full D has 8 elements. Domain over b,x only:
    // t omitted (held at 0) -> 4 elements, fraction 1/2, not coverage.
    let domain = parse(
        r#"{"bundles":[{"name":"b","width":1,"lo":0,"hi":1},{"name":"x","width":1,"lo":0,"hi":1}],"borrowed":[],"regions":[]}"#,
    )
    .unwrap();
    let d = resolve_domain(&domain, &iface, 0).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(d.n.to_string(), "4");
    assert_eq!(d.full_n.to_string(), "8");
    assert_eq!(d.covered_fraction(), "1/2");
    assert!(!d.covers_full);
    // Enumeration: last component fastest; omitted t stays 0.
    let els: Vec<_> = d.elements().collect();
    assert_eq!(els.len(), 4);
    assert!(
        els.iter().all(|e| e.bundles[0].to_string() == "0"),
        "t omitted must be 0"
    );
    let bx: Vec<(String, String)> = els
        .iter()
        .map(|e| (e.bundles[1].to_string(), e.bundles[2].to_string()))
        .collect();
    assert_eq!(
        bx,
        [
            ("0".into(), "0".into()),
            ("0".into(), "1".into()),
            ("1".into(), "0".into()),
            ("1".into(), "1".into())
        ]
    );
}

#[test]
fn full_domain_by_resolved_identity() {
    let o = t3();
    let iface = o.interface("borrow_tuple").unwrap();
    let domain = parse(
        r#"{"bundles":[{"name":"t","width":1,"lo":0,"hi":1},{"name":"b","width":1,"lo":0,"hi":1},{"name":"x","width":1,"lo":0,"hi":1}],"borrowed":[],"regions":[]}"#,
    )
    .unwrap();
    let d = resolve_domain(&domain, &iface, 0).unwrap();
    assert!(d.covers_full);
    assert_eq!(d.covered_fraction(), "1/1");
    // Duplicate component, width mismatch, out-of-range hi: all ill-formed.
    for bad in [
        r#"{"bundles":[{"name":"t","width":1,"lo":0,"hi":1},{"name":"t","width":1,"lo":0,"hi":1}],"borrowed":[],"regions":[]}"#,
        r#"{"bundles":[{"name":"t","width":2,"lo":0,"hi":1}],"borrowed":[],"regions":[]}"#,
        r#"{"bundles":[{"name":"t","width":1,"lo":0,"hi":2}],"borrowed":[],"regions":[]}"#,
        r#"{"bundles":[{"name":"t","width":1,"lo":1,"hi":0}],"borrowed":[],"regions":[]}"#,
        r#"{"bundles":[],"borrowed":[{"name":"z","width":1,"lo":0,"hi":1}],"regions":[]}"#,
    ] {
        let d = parse(bad).unwrap();
        assert!(
            matches!(resolve_domain(&d, &iface, 0), Err(ResolveError::Reject(_))),
            "must reject: {bad}"
        );
    }
}

#[test]
fn oracle_full_domain_includes_tgt_and_fault() {
    // D-expected-oracle-claim: inc2 D is x(2) x tgt(2) x fault(4) = 256.
    let o = t3();
    let iface = o.interface("inc2").unwrap();
    let domain = parse(
        r#"{"bundles":[{"name":"x","width":2,"lo":0,"hi":3},{"name":"t","width":2,"lo":0,"hi":3},{"name":"f","width":4,"lo":0,"hi":15}],"borrowed":[],"regions":[]}"#,
    )
    .unwrap();
    let d = resolve_domain(&domain, &iface, 0).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(d.n.to_string(), "256");
    assert!(d.covers_full);
    // Input-only domain is a slice: 4 of 256.
    let domain =
        parse(r#"{"bundles":[{"name":"x","width":2,"lo":0,"hi":3}],"borrowed":[],"regions":[]}"#)
            .unwrap();
    let d = resolve_domain(&domain, &iface, 0).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(d.covered_fraction(), "1/64");
    assert!(!d.covers_full);
}

#[test]
fn sampler_singleton_components_draw_no_words() {
    // CLAIM-REPLAY witness: sampler seed [1,0,0,0], count 4 over singleton
    // components draws no generator words; 1 distinct of 2^25 full tuples.
    let mut s = Sampler::new(["1", "0", "0", "0"]).unwrap();
    let ranges = [(7u64, 7u64), (0, 0), (3, 3)];
    for _ in 0..4 {
        let el: Vec<String> = ranges
            .iter()
            .map(|(lo, hi)| s.draw_component(*lo, *hi).to_string())
            .collect();
        assert_eq!(el, ["7", "0", "3"]);
    }
    // State must be untouched (no words drawn for R=1).
    assert_eq!(s.state(), [1, 0, 0, 0]);
    // All-zero seed rejects.
    assert!(Sampler::new(["0", "0", "0", "0"]).is_err());
    // Non-canonical seed words reject.
    assert!(Sampler::new(["01", "0", "0", "0"]).is_err());
    assert!(Sampler::new(["18446744073709551616", "0", "0", "0"]).is_err());
}

#[test]
fn sampler_draws_are_deterministic_and_in_range() {
    let o = t3();
    let iface = o.interface("inc2").unwrap();
    let domain = parse(
        r#"{"bundles":[{"name":"x","width":2,"lo":0,"hi":3},{"name":"t","width":2,"lo":0,"hi":3},{"name":"f","width":4,"lo":0,"hi":15}],"borrowed":[],"regions":[]}"#,
    )
    .unwrap();
    let d = resolve_domain(&domain, &iface, 0).unwrap();
    let a = draw_elements(&d, ["1", "0", "0", "0"], 16).unwrap();
    let b = draw_elements(&d, ["1", "0", "0", "0"], 16).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(a, b, "same seed must replay identically");
    assert_eq!(a.len(), 16);
    for el in &a {
        assert!(el.bundles[0] < 4u32.into());
        assert!(el.bundles[2] < 16u32.into());
    }
    let distinct: std::collections::HashSet<String> = a.iter().map(|e| format!("{e:?}")).collect();
    assert!(distinct.len() > 1, "16 draws over 256 must vary");
}

#[test]
fn huge_region_domain_is_host_limit_not_reject() {
    // K75: region[63,1] cells:"all" is legal; an unable host reports
    // unchecked (host limit), never ill-formed. Modelled by capping the
    // materialised element size; resolution with the production cap must
    // classify as HostLimit once element/count materialisation is needed.
    let iface = bennett_cert_checker::object::Interface {
        bundles: vec![],
        borrowed_widths: vec![],
        args: vec![],
        bounds: vec![],
        regions: vec![bennett_cert_checker::object::RegionInfo {
            name: "m".into(),
            group: "in".into(),
            slot: 0,
            a: 63,
            w: 1,
            role: "in".into(),
        }],
    };
    let domain =
        parse(r#"{"bundles":[],"borrowed":[],"regions":[{"name":"m","cells":"all"}]}"#).unwrap();
    match resolve_domain(&domain, &iface, 0) {
        Err(ResolveError::HostLimit(h)) => assert!(h.quantity.contains("63")),
        other => panic!("region[63,1] must terminate normally as a host limitation: {other:?}"),
    }
}
````

````rust
//! ISA-12.2: rejection records and legal host limits are distinct.
use bennett_cert_checker::{
    fault::{HostLimit, Reject, ResolveError},
    json::parse,
};

#[test]
fn rejection_paths_json_and_display_preserve_every_field() {
    let error = Reject::new("E_CERT_DOMAIN", "§12.2", "domain.width", "width mismatch");
    let expected = parse(r#"{"code":"E_CERT_DOMAIN","section":"§12.2","path":"regions.root.domain.width","message":"width mismatch"}"#).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(error.at("regions.root").to_value(), expected);
    assert_eq!(error.at("").path, "domain.width");
    assert_eq!(Reject::new("X", "§12.2", "", "m").at("claim").path, "claim");
    assert_eq!(
        error.to_string(),
        "E_CERT_DOMAIN (§12.2) at domain.width: width mismatch"
    );
    assert_eq!(error.path, "domain.width");
    assert_eq!(
        ResolveError::from(error.clone()),
        ResolveError::Reject(error)
    );
}

#[test]
fn host_limits_remain_non_rejections_with_the_original_quantity() {
    let limit = HostLimit {
        quantity: "domain element count 18446744073709551616".into(),
    };
    assert_eq!(
        ResolveError::from(limit.clone()),
        ResolveError::HostLimit(limit)
    );
}
````

````rust
use crate::common;
use bennett_cert_checker::{
    cert::{check_certificate, Inputs},
    domain::{resolve_domain, ResolveError},
    json::{jcs, Value},
    object::Object,
    sampler::{draw_elements, Sampler},
    sha256_hex,
};
use common::*;
fn fixture(a: u32, w: u32, image: &str) -> Inputs {
    let address = if a == 0 { "()" } else { "c" };
    let source=format!("perm_action @a (t:wire[{w}] mut) (c:wire in) (r:region[{a},{w}] in) () ()\n^entry():\nd = qload r {address}\nqxor d t\nqunload r {address} d");
    let sig = format!(
        r#"{{"a":{{"abi":"0.9","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[1],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[{{"A":{a},"W":{w},"role":"in"}}],"mut":[{w}],"tier":"q"}}}}"#
    );
    let bytes: Vec<u8> = (0..image.len() / 2)
        .map(|i| u8::from_str_radix(&image[2 * i..2 * i + 2], 16).unwrap())
        .collect();
    let hash = sha256_hex(&bytes);
    let domain = json(&format!(
        r#"{{"fixed_regions":[{{"name":"r","A":{a},"W":{w},"image":"{image}","sha256":"{hash}"}}],"bundles":[{{"name":"t","width":{w},"lo":0,"hi":{}}},{{"name":"c","width":1,"lo":0,"hi":1}}],"borrowed":[],"regions":[]}}"#,
        (1u32 << w) - 1
    ));
    let cells: Vec<u32> = (0..1u32 << a)
        .map(|i| {
            let mut cell = 0;
            for bit in 0..w {
                let j = i * w + bit;
                cell |= u32::from((bytes[(j / 8) as usize] >> (j % 8)) & 1) << bit;
            }
            cell
        })
        .collect();
    let tuple = |t: u32, c: u32| {
        json(&format!(
            r#"{{"bundles":["{t}","{c}"],"borrowed":[],"regions":[{}]}}"#,
            encode(&Value::Arr(
                cells.iter().map(|v| Value::Str(v.to_string())).collect()
            ))
        ))
    };
    let mut rows = vec![];
    for t in 0..1u32 << w {
        for c in 0..2 {
            let mut row = json("{}");
            set(&mut row, "before", tuple(t, c));
            set(
                &mut row,
                "after",
                tuple(t ^ cells[if a == 0 { 0 } else { c as usize }], c),
            );
            rows.push(row);
        }
    }
    let mut claim = json(
        r#"{"kind":"exhaustive","label":"proof_relative_to_image","invocation":{"args":[],"budget":["0","0","0","0"]}}"#,
    );
    set(&mut claim, "domain", domain);
    let mut expected = json("{}");
    set(&mut expected, "table", Value::Arr(rows));
    set(&mut claim, "expected", expected);
    let (mut inputs, h) = standalone(&source, &sig, "a", vec![claim]);
    inputs.object_text=rebind_object_symbols(&format!("{}\nsection layout\n{{\"A_tab\":0,\"H\":4,\"S_cells\":0,\"globals\":{{}},\"heap_base\":1,\"heap_limit_max\":0,\"interface_regions\":{{}},\"null_size\":1,\"ptr_width\":32}}\n",inputs.object_text));
    let object = Object::parse(&inputs.object_text).unwrap();
    let updated = object.symbol("a").unwrap().closure_hash.clone().unwrap();
    let mut cert = json(std::str::from_utf8(&inputs.cert_bytes).unwrap());
    let Value::Obj(top) = &mut cert else { panic!() };
    let Value::Obj(regions) = top.get_mut("regions").unwrap() else {
        panic!()
    };
    let mut record = regions.remove(&h).unwrap();
    let Value::Obj(fields) = &mut record else {
        panic!()
    };
    let Value::Obj(frame) = fields.get_mut("frame").unwrap() else {
        panic!()
    };
    let Value::Arr(slots) = frame.get_mut("slots").unwrap() else {
        panic!()
    };
    slots.push(json(&format!(
        r#"{{"class":"fast","id":"mem:0","role":"mem_in","width":{}}}"#,
        (1u32 << a) * w
    )));
    let Value::Arr(claims) = fields.get_mut("claims").unwrap() else {
        panic!()
    };
    let mut subject = claims[0].get("subject").unwrap().clone();
    set(&mut subject, "closure_hash", Value::Str(updated.clone()));
    set(&mut claims[0], "subject", subject);
    regions.insert(updated.clone(), record);
    set(
        top.get_mut("bindings").unwrap(),
        "object_hash",
        Value::Str(object.object_hash.clone()),
    );
    for key in ["interface_hash", "closure_hash", "reference_program_hash"] {
        set(
            top.get_mut("bindings").unwrap(),
            key,
            Value::Str(updated.clone()),
        );
    }
    inputs.cert_bytes = jcs(&cert).unwrap();
    inputs
}
fn claim_mut(inputs: &mut Inputs, f: impl FnOnce(&mut Value)) {
    let mut cert = json(std::str::from_utf8(&inputs.cert_bytes).unwrap());
    let Value::Obj(top) = &mut cert else { panic!() };
    let Value::Obj(regions) = top.get_mut("regions").unwrap() else {
        panic!()
    };
    let Value::Obj(r) = regions.values_mut().next().unwrap() else {
        panic!()
    };
    let Value::Arr(claims) = r.get_mut("claims").unwrap() else {
        panic!()
    };
    f(&mut claims[0]);
    inputs.cert_bytes = jcs(&cert).unwrap();
}
#[test]
fn fixed_image_claims_replay_packed_cells_and_report_a_conditional_theorem() {
    for (a, w, image, fraction) in [(0, 2, "03", "1/4"), (1, 2, "09", "1/16")] {
        let inputs = fixture(a, w, image);
        let verdict = check_certificate(&inputs);
        assert!(codes(&verdict).is_empty(), "{verdict:?}");
        let outcome = &verdict.regions[0].claims[0].1;
        assert_eq!(outcome.outcome, "proof_relative_to_image", "{verdict:?}");
        assert_eq!(outcome.covered_fraction.as_deref(), Some(fraction));
        assert_eq!(outcome.elements.as_deref(), Some("8"));
        assert!(outcome.establishes.contains("conditional"));
        let report = verdict.to_value();
        assert!(encode(&report).contains("fixed_regions"), "{report:?}");
    }
}
#[test]
fn conditional_and_sampled_results_cannot_satisfy_unrestricted_proof_requests() {
    for label in ["proof", "proof_relative_to_image", "evidence"] {
        for sampled in [false, true] {
            let mut inputs = fixture(0, 2, "03");
            claim_mut(&mut inputs, |c| {
                set(c, "label", Value::Str(label.into()));
                if sampled {
                    set(c, "kind", Value::Str("sampled".into()));
                    set(
                        c,
                        "sampler",
                        json(r#"{"algorithm":"xoshiro256**","seed":["1","0","0","0"],"count":1}"#),
                    );
                }
            });
            let verdict = check_certificate(&inputs);
            if label == "proof" || (sampled && label == "proof_relative_to_image") {
                assert!(
                    codes(&verdict).contains(&"E_CERT_COVERAGE_LABEL"),
                    "{label} sampled={sampled}: {verdict:?}"
                );
            } else {
                assert!(codes(&verdict).is_empty(), "{verdict:?}");
                assert_eq!(
                    verdict.regions[0].claims[0].1.outcome,
                    if sampled {
                        "evidence"
                    } else {
                        "proof_relative_to_image"
                    }
                );
            }
        }
    }
}

fn fixed_cells_do_not_consume_sampler_words_or_enumeration_positions() {

#[test]
fn image_relative_coverage_requires_every_other_component_including_inherited_controls() {
    let mut inputs = fixture(1, 2, "09");
    claim_mut(&mut inputs, |claim| {
        let Value::Obj(fields) = claim else { panic!() };
        let Value::Obj(domain) = fields.get_mut("domain").unwrap() else {
            panic!()
        };
        let Value::Arr(bundles) = domain.get_mut("bundles").unwrap() else {
            panic!()
        };
        bundles.insert(0, json(r#"{"name":"inherited","width":1,"lo":0,"hi":1}"#));
        let Value::Obj(subject) = fields.get_mut("subject").unwrap() else {
            panic!()
        };
        subject.insert("inherited_controls".into(), json("1"));
        let Value::Obj(expected) = fields.get_mut("expected").unwrap() else {
            panic!()
        };
        let Value::Arr(rows) = expected.get_mut("table").unwrap() else {
            panic!()
        };
        let original = rows.clone();
        rows.clear();
        for control in 0..2 {
            for row in &original {
                let mut row = row.clone();
                let before = row.get("before").unwrap().clone();
                let Value::Obj(r) = &mut row else { panic!() };
                if control == 0 {
                    r.insert("after".into(), before);
                }
                for key in ["before", "after"] {
                    let Value::Obj(t) = r.get_mut(key).unwrap() else {
                        panic!()
                    };
                    let Value::Arr(b) = t.get_mut("bundles").unwrap() else {
                        panic!()
                    };
                    b.insert(0, Value::Str(control.to_string()));
                }
                rows.push(row);
            }
        }
    });
    let verdict = check_certificate(&inputs);
    assert!(codes(&verdict).is_empty(), "{verdict:?}");
    assert_eq!(
        verdict.overall, "unchecked",
        "preparation has not been established: {verdict:?}"
    );
    let outcome = &verdict.regions[0].claims[0].1;
    assert_eq!(outcome.outcome, "proof_relative_to_image");
    assert_eq!(outcome.elements.as_deref(), Some("16"));
    assert_eq!(outcome.covered_fraction.as_deref(), Some("1/16"));
    // Restrict the inherited control to zero. The theorem now misses a
    // non-image component, so its strongest outcome is evidence.
    for label in ["proof_relative_to_image", "evidence"] {
        let mut narrowed = inputs.clone();
        claim_mut(&mut narrowed, |claim| {
            set(claim, "label", Value::Str(label.into()));
            let Value::Obj(c) = claim else { panic!() };
            let Value::Obj(d) = c.get_mut("domain").unwrap() else {
                panic!()
            };
            let Value::Arr(b) = d.get_mut("bundles").unwrap() else {
                panic!()
            };
            set(&mut b[0], "hi", json("0"));
            let Value::Obj(e) = c.get_mut("expected").unwrap() else {
                panic!()
            };
            let Value::Arr(rows) = e.get_mut("table").unwrap() else {
                panic!()
            };
            rows.truncate(8);
        });
        let verdict = check_certificate(&narrowed);
        if label == "evidence" {
            assert!(codes(&verdict).is_empty(), "{verdict:?}");
            assert_eq!(verdict.regions[0].claims[0].1.outcome, "evidence");
            assert_eq!(
                verdict.regions[0].claims[0].1.covered_fraction.as_deref(),
                Some("1/32")
            );
        } else {
            assert!(
                codes(&verdict).contains(&"E_CERT_COVERAGE_LABEL"),
                "{verdict:?}"
            );
        }
    }
}
#[test]
fn fixed_bindings_follow_interface_order_and_legal_large_images_are_host_limited() {
    let inputs = fixture(1, 2, "09");
    let object = Object::parse(&inputs.object_text).unwrap();
    let cert = json(std::str::from_utf8(&inputs.cert_bytes).unwrap());
    let claim = cert
        .get("regions")
        .unwrap()
        .as_obj()
        .unwrap()
        .values()
        .next()
        .unwrap()
        .get("claims")
        .unwrap()
        .as_arr()
        .unwrap()[0]
        .clone();
    let mut iface = object.interface("a").unwrap();
    let mut domain = claim.get("domain").unwrap().clone();
    let mut extra = iface.regions[0].clone();
    extra.name = "s".into();
    extra.slot = 1;
    extra.a = 0;
    extra.w = 1;
    iface.regions.push(extra);
    let mut images = domain
        .get("fixed_regions")
        .unwrap()
        .as_arr()
        .unwrap()
        .to_vec();
    images.insert(
        0,
        json(&format!(
            r#"{{"name":"s","A":0,"W":1,"image":"01","sha256":"{}"}}"#,
            sha256_hex(&[1])
        )),
    );
    set(&mut domain, "fixed_regions", Value::Arr(images));
    let resolved = resolve_domain(&domain, &iface, 0).unwrap();
    assert!(resolved.covers_relative_to_image);
    assert_eq!(
        resolved
            .fixed_regions
            .iter()
            .map(|r| r.position)
            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
        vec![0, 1]
    );
    assert_eq!(
        resolved.zero_tuple().regions,
        vec![vec![1u32.into(), 2u32.into()], vec![1u32.into()]]
    );
    iface.regions.truncate(1);
    iface.regions[0].a = 20;
    iface.regions[0].w = 1;
    let bytes = vec![0; 1 << 17];
    set(
        &mut domain,
        "fixed_regions",
        json(&format!(
            r#"[{{"name":"r","A":20,"W":1,"image":"{}","sha256":"{}"}}]"#,
            "00".repeat(bytes.len()),
            sha256_hex(&bytes)
        )),
    );
    assert!(matches!(
        resolve_domain(&domain, &iface, 0),
        Err(ResolveError::HostLimit(_))
    ));
}
````

````rust
use crate::common;
use bennett_cert_checker::{
    cert::{check_certificate, Inputs},
    json::{jcs, Value},
    sha256_hex,
};
use common::*;
fn fixture() -> Inputs {
    let rows=(0..4).map(|v|json(&format!(r#"{{"before":{{"bundles":["{v}"],"borrowed":[],"regions":[]}},"after":{{"bundles":["{}"],"borrowed":[],"regions":[]}}}}"#,v^3))).collect();
    let mut claim = json(
        r#"{"kind":"exhaustive","label":"proof","invocation":{"args":[],"budget":["0","0","0","0"]},"domain":{"bundles":[{"name":"t","width":2,"lo":0,"hi":3}],"borrowed":[],"regions":[]},"expected":{}}"#,
    );
    let mut expected = json("{}");
    set(&mut expected, "table", Value::Arr(rows));
    set(&mut claim, "expected", expected);
    let (mut inputs, h) = standalone(
        "perm_action @split (t:wire[2] mut) () () () ()\n^entry():\nx t[0]\nx t[1]",
        r#"{"split":{"abi":"0.9","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[],"kind":"perm_action","mem":[],"mut":[2],"tier":"q"}}"#,
        "split",
        vec![claim],
    );
    let base = controlled();
    let mut target = json(std::str::from_utf8(base.target_bytes.as_ref().unwrap()).unwrap());
    set(
        &mut target,
        "classes",
        json(
            r#"{"A":{"capacity":2,"dirty_rate":1,"qubit_second":1},"B":{"capacity":2,"dirty_rate":1,"qubit_second":1}}"#,
        ),
    );
    let mut gate = target.get("gates").unwrap().as_arr().unwrap()[0].clone();
    set(&mut gate, "classes", json(r#"["*"]"#));
    set(&mut gate, "controls", json(r#"{"min":0,"max":0}"#));
    set(&mut target, "gates", Value::Arr(vec![gate]));
    let mut cert = json(std::str::from_utf8(&inputs.cert_bytes).unwrap());
    let Value::Obj(top) = &mut cert else { panic!() };
    set(
        top.get_mut("bindings").unwrap(),
        "target_hash",
        Value::Str(sha256_hex(&jcs(&target).unwrap())),
    );
    let Value::Obj(regions) = top.get_mut("regions").unwrap() else {
        panic!()
    };
    set(
        regions.get_mut(&h).unwrap(),
        "frame",
        json(
            r#"{"slots":[{"id":"mut:0","role":"mut","width":2,"fragments":[{"offset":0,"width":1,"class":"A"},{"offset":1,"width":1,"class":"B"}]}],"scratch":[],"history":[],"borrow":[],"ancillae":[]}"#,
        ),
    );
    inputs.cert_bytes = jcs(&cert).unwrap();
    inputs.target_bytes = Some(jcs(&target).unwrap());
    inputs
}
fn mutate(inputs: &mut Inputs, f: impl FnOnce(&mut Value)) {
    let mut cert = json(std::str::from_utf8(&inputs.cert_bytes).unwrap());
    let Value::Obj(top) = &mut cert else { panic!() };
    let Value::Obj(regions) = top.get_mut("regions").unwrap() else {
        panic!()
    };
    let Value::Obj(r) = regions.values_mut().next().unwrap() else {
        panic!()
    };
    let Value::Obj(frame) = r.get_mut("frame").unwrap() else {
        panic!()
    };
    let Value::Arr(slots) = frame.get_mut("slots").unwrap() else {
        panic!()
    };
    f(&mut slots[0]);
    inputs.cert_bytes = jcs(&cert).unwrap();
}

    );
    assert_eq!(
        verdict.overall, "unchecked",

    );

        verdict.regions[0]
            .unchecked_items
            .iter()
            .any(|x| x.contains("fragmented")),

    );
}
#[test]
fn fragment_gaps_overlaps_order_classes_merge_and_exclusive_forms_reject() {
    for text in [
        r#"[{"offset":1,"width":1,"class":"A"},{"offset":2,"width":1,"class":"B"}]"#,
        r#"[{"offset":0,"width":1,"class":"A"},{"offset":0,"width":1,"class":"B"}]"#,
        r#"[{"offset":1,"width":1,"class":"B"},{"offset":0,"width":1,"class":"A"}]"#,
        r#"[{"offset":0,"width":1,"class":"A"},{"offset":1,"width":2,"class":"B"}]"#,
        r#"[{"offset":0,"width":1,"class":"A"},{"offset":1,"width":1,"class":"A"}]"#,
        r#"[{"offset":0,"width":1,"class":"A"},{"offset":1,"width":1,"class":"C"}]"#,
        r#"[{"offset":0,"width":2,"class":"A"}]"#,
        r#"[{"offset":0,"width":0,"class":"A"},{"offset":0,"width":2,"class":"B"}]"#,
        "[]",
    ] {
        let mut inputs = fixture();
        mutate(&mut inputs, |slot| set(slot, "fragments", json(text)));
        let verdict = check_certificate(&inputs);
        assert!(
            codes(&verdict).contains(&"E_CERT_FRAME"),
            "{text}: {verdict:?}"
        );
    }
    let mut inputs = fixture();
    mutate(&mut inputs, |slot| {
        set(slot, "class", Value::Str("A".into()))
    });
    let verdict = check_certificate(&inputs);
    assert!(codes(&verdict).contains(&"E_CERT_FRAME"), "{verdict:?}");
}
#[test]
fn every_fragment_field_type_position_and_required_removal_rejects() {
    let mut mutations = 0;
    let mut removals = 0;
    let mut inputs = fixture();
    mutate(&mut inputs, |slot| set(slot, "fragments", Value::Null));
    assert!(codes(&check_certificate(&inputs)).contains(&"E_CERT_FRAME"));
    mutations += 1;
    for i in 0..2 {
        let mut inputs = fixture();
        mutate(&mut inputs, |slot| {
            let Value::Obj(m) = slot else { panic!() };
            let Value::Arr(a) = m.get_mut("fragments").unwrap() else {
                panic!()
            };
            a[i] = Value::Null;
        });
        assert!(codes(&check_certificate(&inputs)).contains(&"E_CERT_FRAME"));
        mutations += 1;
        for key in ["offset", "width", "class"] {
            for remove in [false, true] {
                let mut inputs = fixture();
                mutate(&mut inputs, |slot| {
                    let Value::Obj(m) = slot else { panic!() };
                    let Value::Arr(a) = m.get_mut("fragments").unwrap() else {
                        panic!()
                    };
                    let Value::Obj(f) = &mut a[i] else { panic!() };
                    if remove {
                        f.remove(key);
                    } else {
                        f.insert(key.into(), Value::Null);
                    }
                });
                let verdict = check_certificate(&inputs);
                assert!(
                    codes(&verdict).contains(&"E_CERT_FRAME"),
                    "i={i} key={key} remove={remove}: {verdict:?}"
                );
                if remove {
                    removals += 1;
                } else {
                    mutations += 1;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    let mut inputs = fixture();
    mutate(&mut inputs, |slot| {
        let Value::Obj(m) = slot else { panic!() };
        m.remove("fragments");
    });
    assert!(codes(&check_certificate(&inputs)).contains(&"E_CERT_FRAME"));
    removals += 1;
    assert_eq!((mutations, removals), (9, 7));
}
````
